 13 | ## 友情提示
 14 | 
 15 | > 1. **快速体验项目**：[在线访问地址](https://cloud.macrozheng.com/admin/index.html) 。
 16 | > 2. **全套学习教程**：[《mall-swarm微服务学习教程》](https://cloud.macrozheng.com) 。
 17 | > 3. **视频教程（2024最新版）**：[《mall-swarm视频教程》](https://cloud.macrozheng.com/video/) 。
 18 | > 4. **Spring Cloud全套教程**：[《SpringCloud学习教程》](https://github.com/macrozheng/springcloud-learning) 。
 19 | > 5. **分支说明**：`master`分支基于Spring Cloud 2023+Spring Boot 3.2，`dev-v2`分支基于Spring Cloud 2021+Spring Boot 2.7。
 20 | 
 21 | ## 项目简介
 22 | 
 23 | `mall-swarm`是一套微服务商城系统，采用了 Spring Cloud 2023 & Alibaba、Spring Boot 3.2、Sa-Token、MyBatis、Elasticsearch、Docker、Kubernetes等核心技术，同时提供了基于Vue的管理后台方便快速搭建系统。`mall-swarm`在电商业务的基础集成了注册中心、配置中心、监控中心、网关等系统功能。文档齐全，附带全套Spring Cloud教程。
 24 |

 43 | ## 项目架构
 44 | 
 45 | ### 系统架构
 46 | 
 47 | ![系统架构图](./document/resource/mall_micro_service_arch.jpg)
 48 | 
 49 | ### 业务架构
 50 | 
 51 | ![业务架构图](./document/resource/re_mall_business_arch.jpg)
 52 | 
 53 | ### 组织结构
 54 | 
 55 | ``` lua
 56 | mall
 57 | ├── mall-common -- 工具类及通用代码模块
 58 | ├── mall-mbg -- MyBatisGenerator生成的数据库操作代码模块
 59 | ├── mall-auth -- 基于Spring Security Oauth2的统一的认证中心
 60 | ├── mall-gateway -- 基于Spring Cloud Gateway的微服务API网关服务
 61 | ├── mall-monitor -- 基于Spring Boot Admin的微服务监控中心
 62 | ├── mall-admin -- 后台管理系统服务
 63 | ├── mall-search -- 基于Elasticsearch的商品搜索系统服务
 64 | ├── mall-portal -- 移动端商城系统服务
 65 | ├── mall-demo -- 微服务远程调用测试服务
 66 | └── config -- 配置中心存储的配置
 67 | ```

```xml
 1 | <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
 2 | <!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
 3 | <mapper namespace="com.macro.mall.dao.PmsProductDao">
 4 |     <resultMap id="updateInfoMap" type="com.macro.mall.dto.PmsProductResult" extends="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsProductMapper.ResultMapWithBLOBs">
 5 |         <result column="cateParentId" jdbcType="BIGINT" property="cateParentId" />
 6 |         <collection property="productLadderList" columnPrefix="ladder_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsProductLadderMapper.BaseResultMap">
 7 |         </collection>
 8 |         <collection property="productFullReductionList" columnPrefix="full_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsProductFullReductionMapper.BaseResultMap">
 9 |         </collection>
10 |         <collection property="memberPriceList" columnPrefix="member_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsMemberPriceMapper.BaseResultMap">
11 |         </collection>
12 |         <collection property="skuStockList" columnPrefix="sku_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsSkuStockMapper.BaseResultMap">
13 |         </collection>
14 |         <collection property="productAttributeValueList" columnPrefix="attribute_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsProductAttributeValueMapper.BaseResultMap">
15 |         </collection>
16 |         <collection property="subjectProductRelationList" column="{productId=id}" select="selectSubjectProductRelationByProductId"/>
17 |         <collection property="prefrenceAreaProductRelationList" column="{productId=id}" select="selectPrefrenceAreaProductRelationByProductId"/>
18 | 
19 |     </resultMap>
20 | 
21 |     <select id="getUpdateInfo" resultMap="updateInfoMap">
22 |         SELECT *,
23 |             pc.parent_id cateParentId,
24 |             l.id ladder_id,l.product_id ladder_product_id,l.discount ladder_discount,l.count ladder_count,l.price ladder_price,
25 |             pf.id full_id,pf.product_id full_product_id,pf.full_price full_full_price,pf.reduce_price full_reduce_price,
26 |             m.id member_id,m.product_id member_product_id,m.member_level_id member_member_level_id,m.member_price member_member_price,m.member_level_name member_member_level_name,
27 |             s.id sku_id,s.product_id sku_product_id,s.price sku_price,s.low_stock sku_low_stock,s.pic sku_pic,s.sale sku_sale,s.sku_code sku_sku_code,s.stock sku_stock,s.sp_data sku_sp_data,
28 |             a.id attribute_id,a.product_id attribute_product_id,a.product_attribute_id attribute_product_attribute_id,a.value attribute_value
29 |         FROM pms_product p
30 |         LEFT JOIN pms_product_category pc on pc.id = p.product_category_id
31 |         LEFT JOIN pms_product_ladder l ON p.id = l.product_id
32 |         LEFT JOIN pms_product_full_reduction pf ON pf.product_id=p.id
33 |         LEFT JOIN pms_member_price m ON m.product_id = p.id
34 |         LEFT JOIN pms_sku_stock s ON s.product_id = p.id
35 |         LEFT JOIN pms_product_attribute_value a ON a.product_id=p.id
36 |         WHERE p.id=#{id};
37 |     </select>
38 |     <select id="selectSubjectProductRelationByProductId" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.CmsSubjectProductRelationMapper.BaseResultMap">
39 |         select * from cms_subject_product_relation where product_id=#{productId}
40 |     </select>
41 |     <select id="selectPrefrenceAreaProductRelationByProductId" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.CmsPrefrenceAreaProductRelationMapper.BaseResultMap">
42 |         select * from cms_prefrence_area_product_relation where product_id=#{productId}
43 |     </select>
44 | 
45 | </mapper>
```

- Modified: 2025-08-15 12:10:36

### Code

```xml
 1 | <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
 2 | <!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
 3 | <mapper namespace="com.macro.mall.dao.OmsOrderDao">
 4 |     <resultMap id="orderDetailResultMap" type="com.macro.mall.dto.OmsOrderDetail" extends="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderMapper.BaseResultMap">
 5 |         <collection property="orderItemList" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderItemMapper.BaseResultMap" columnPrefix="item_"/>
 6 |         <collection property="historyList" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderOperateHistoryMapper.BaseResultMap" columnPrefix="history_"/>
 7 |     </resultMap>
 8 |     <select id="getList" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderMapper.BaseResultMap">
 9 |         SELECT *
10 |         FROM
11 |         oms_order
12 |         WHERE
13 |         delete_status = 0
14 |         <if test="queryParam.orderSn!=null and queryParam.orderSn!=''">
15 |             AND order_sn = #{queryParam.orderSn}
16 |         </if>
17 |         <if test="queryParam.status!=null">
18 |             AND `status` = #{queryParam.status}
19 |         </if>
20 |         <if test="queryParam.sourceType!=null">
21 |             AND source_type = #{queryParam.sourceType}
22 |         </if>
23 |         <if test="queryParam.orderType!=null">
24 |             AND order_type = #{queryParam.orderType}
25 |         </if>
26 |         <if test="queryParam.createTime!=null and queryParam.createTime!=''">
27 |             AND create_time LIKE concat(#{queryParam.createTime},"%")
28 |         </if>
29 |         <if test="queryParam.receiverKeyword!=null and queryParam.receiverKeyword!=''">
30 |             AND (
31 |             receiver_name LIKE concat("%",#{queryParam.receiverKeyword},"%")
32 |             OR receiver_phone LIKE concat("%",#{queryParam.receiverKeyword},"%")
33 |             )
34 |         </if>
35 |     </select>
36 |     <update id="delivery">
37 |         UPDATE oms_order
38 |         SET
39 |         delivery_sn = CASE id
40 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item">
41 |             WHEN #{item.orderId} THEN #{item.deliverySn}
42 |         </foreach>
43 |         END,
44 |         delivery_company = CASE id
45 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item">
46 |             WHEN #{item.orderId} THEN #{item.deliveryCompany}
47 |         </foreach>
48 |         END,
49 |         delivery_time = CASE id
50 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item">
51 |             WHEN #{item.orderId} THEN now()
52 |         </foreach>
53 |         END,
54 |         `status` = CASE id
55 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item">
56 |             WHEN #{item.orderId} THEN 2
57 |         </foreach>
58 |         END
59 |         WHERE
60 |         id IN
61 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item" separator="," open="(" close=")">
62 |             #{item.orderId}
63 |         </foreach>
64 |         AND `status` = 1
65 |     </update>
66 |     <select id="getDetail" resultMap="orderDetailResultMap">
67 |         SELECT o.*,
68 |             oi.id item_id,
69 |             oi.product_id item_product_id,
70 |             oi.product_sn item_product_sn,
71 |             oi.product_pic item_product_pic,
72 |             oi.product_name item_product_name,
73 |             oi.product_brand item_product_brand,
74 |             oi.product_price item_product_price,
75 |             oi.product_quantity item_product_quantity,
76 |             oi.product_attr item_product_attr,
77 |             oh.id history_id,
78 |             oh.operate_man history_operate_man,
79 |             oh.create_time history_create_time,
80 |             oh.order_status history_order_status,
81 |             oh.note history_note
82 |         FROM
83 |             oms_order o
84 |             LEFT JOIN oms_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
85 |             LEFT JOIN oms_order_operate_history oh ON o.id = oh.order_id
86 |         WHERE
87 |             o.id = #{id}
88 |         ORDER BY oi.id ASC,oh.create_time DESC
89 |     </select>
90 | </mapper>
```

```xml
11 |         member_username,

14 |         return_name,
15 |         status,

20 |         1 = 1

22 |             AND id = #{queryParam.id}
23 |         </if>
24 |         <if test="queryParam.status!=null">
25 |             AND status = #{queryParam.status}
26 |         </if>
27 |         <if test="queryParam.status!=null">
28 |             AND status = #{queryParam.status}
29 |         </if>

42 |         </if>
43 |     </select>

54 |         FROM

57 |         WHERE ra.id=#{id};
```

```xml
 3 | <mapper namespace="com.macro.mall.dao.PmsProductDao">
 4 |     <resultMap id="updateInfoMap" type="com.macro.mall.dto.PmsProductResult" extends="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsProductMapper.ResultMapWithBLOBs">
 5 |         <result column="cateParentId" jdbcType="BIGINT" property="cateParentId" />
 6 |         <collection property="productLadderList" columnPrefix="ladder_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsProductLadderMapper.BaseResultMap">
 7 |         </collection>
 8 |         <collection property="productFullReductionList" columnPrefix="full_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsProductFullReductionMapper.BaseResultMap">
 9 |         </collection>
10 |         <collection property="memberPriceList" columnPrefix="member_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsMemberPriceMapper.BaseResultMap">
11 |         </collection>
12 |         <collection property="skuStockList" columnPrefix="sku_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsSkuStockMapper.BaseResultMap">
13 |         </collection>
14 |         <collection property="productAttributeValueList" columnPrefix="attribute_" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.PmsProductAttributeValueMapper.BaseResultMap">
15 |         </collection>
16 |         <collection property="subjectProductRelationList" column="{productId=id}" select="selectSubjectProductRelationByProductId"/>
17 |         <collection property="prefrenceAreaProductRelationList" column="{productId=id}" select="selectPrefrenceAreaProductRelationByProductId"/>
18 | 
19 |     </resultMap>
20 | 
21 |     <select id="getUpdateInfo" resultMap="updateInfoMap">
22 |         SELECT *,
23 |             pc.parent_id cateParentId,
24 |             l.id ladder_id,l.product_id ladder_product_id,l.discount ladder_discount,l.count ladder_count,l.price ladder_price,
25 |             pf.id full_id,pf.product_id full_product_id,pf.full_price full_full_price,pf.reduce_price full_reduce_price,
26 |             m.id member_id,m.product_id member_product_id,m.member_level_id member_member_level_id,m.member_price member_member_price,m.member_level_name member_member_level_name,
27 |             s.id sku_id,s.product_id sku_product_id,s.price sku_price,s.low_stock sku_low_stock,s.pic sku_pic,s.sale sku_sale,s.sku_code sku_sku_code,s.stock sku_stock,s.sp_data sku_sp_data,
28 |             a.id attribute_id,a.product_id attribute_product_id,a.product_attribute_id attribute_product_attribute_id,a.value attribute_value
29 |         FROM pms_product p
30 |         LEFT JOIN pms_product_category pc on pc.id = p.product_category_id
31 |         LEFT JOIN pms_product_ladder l ON p.id = l.product_id
32 |         LEFT JOIN pms_product_full_reduction pf ON pf.product_id=p.id
33 |         LEFT JOIN pms_member_price m ON m.product_id = p.id
34 |         LEFT JOIN pms_sku_stock s ON s.product_id = p.id
35 |         LEFT JOIN pms_product_attribute_value a ON a.product_id=p.id
36 |         WHERE p.id=#{id};
37 |     </select>
38 |     <select id="selectSubjectProductRelationByProductId" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.CmsSubjectProductRelationMapper.BaseResultMap">
39 |         select * from cms_subject_product_relation where product_id=#{productId}
40 |     </select>
41 |     <select id="selectPrefrenceAreaProductRelationByProductId" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.CmsPrefrenceAreaProductRelationMapper.BaseResultMap">
42 |         select * from cms_prefrence_area_product_relation where product_id=#{productId}
43 |     </select>
44 | 
45 | </mapper>
```

- Extension: .xml
- Language: xml

- Modified: 2025-08-14 16:52:16

### Code

```xml
 1 | <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
 2 | <!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
 3 | <mapper namespace="com.macro.mall.dao.OmsOrderDao">
 4 |     <resultMap id="orderDetailResultMap" type="com.macro.mall.dto.OmsOrderDetail" extends="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderMapper.BaseResultMap">
 5 |         <collection property="orderItemList" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderItemMapper.BaseResultMap" columnPrefix="item_"/>
 6 |         <collection property="historyList" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderOperateHistoryMapper.BaseResultMap" columnPrefix="history_"/>
 7 |     </resultMap>
 8 |     <select id="getList" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderMapper.BaseResultMap">
 9 |         SELECT *
10 |         FROM
11 |         oms_order
12 |         WHERE
13 |         delete_status = 0
14 |         <if test="queryParam.orderSn!=null and queryParam.orderSn!=''">
15 |             AND order_sn = #{queryParam.orderSn}
16 |         </if>
17 |         <if test="queryParam.status!=null">
18 |             AND `status` = #{queryParam.status}
19 |         </if>
20 |         <if test="queryParam.sourceType!=null">
21 |             AND source_type = #{queryParam.sourceType}
22 |         </if>
23 |         <if test="queryParam.orderType!=null">
24 |             AND order_type = #{queryParam.orderType}
25 |         </if>
26 |         <if test="queryParam.createTime!=null and queryParam.createTime!=''">
27 |             AND create_time LIKE concat(#{queryParam.createTime},"%")
28 |         </if>
29 |         <if test="queryParam.receiverKeyword!=null and queryParam.receiverKeyword!=''">
30 |             AND (
31 |             receiver_name LIKE concat("%",#{queryParam.receiverKeyword},"%")
32 |             OR receiver_phone LIKE concat("%",#{queryParam.receiverKeyword},"%")
33 |             )
34 |         </if>
35 |     </select>
36 |     <update id="delivery">
37 |         UPDATE oms_order
38 |         SET
39 |         delivery_sn = CASE id
40 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item">
41 |             WHEN #{item.orderId} THEN #{item.deliverySn}
42 |         </foreach>
43 |         END,
44 |         delivery_company = CASE id
45 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item">
46 |             WHEN #{item.orderId} THEN #{item.deliveryCompany}
47 |         </foreach>
48 |         END,
49 |         delivery_time = CASE id
50 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item">
51 |             WHEN #{item.orderId} THEN now()
52 |         </foreach>
53 |         END,
54 |         `status` = CASE id
55 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item">
56 |             WHEN #{item.orderId} THEN 2
57 |         </foreach>
58 |         END
59 |         WHERE
60 |         id IN
61 |         <foreach collection="list" item="item" separator="," open="(" close=")">
62 |             #{item.orderId}
63 |         </foreach>
64 |         AND `status` = 1
65 |     </update>
66 |     <select id="getDetail" resultMap="orderDetailResultMap">
67 |         SELECT o.*,
68 |             oi.id item_id,
69 |             oi.product_id item_product_id,
70 |             oi.product_sn item_product_sn,
71 |             oi.product_pic item_product_pic,
72 |             oi.product_name item_product_name,
73 |             oi.product_brand item_product_brand,
74 |             oi.product_price item_product_price,
75 |             oi.product_quantity item_product_quantity,
76 |             oi.product_attr item_product_attr,
77 |             oh.id history_id,
78 |             oh.operate_man history_operate_man,
79 |             oh.create_time history_create_time,
80 |             oh.order_status history_order_status,
81 |             oh.note history_note
82 |         FROM
83 |             oms_order o
84 |             LEFT JOIN oms_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
85 |             LEFT JOIN oms_order_operate_history oh ON o.id = oh.order_id
86 |         WHERE
87 |             o.id = #{id}
88 |         ORDER BY oi.id ASC,oh.create_time DESC
89 |     </select>
90 | </mapper>
```

```xml
 1 | <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
 2 | <!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
 3 | <mapper namespace="com.macro.mall.dao.OmsOrderReturnApplyDao">
 4 |     <resultMap id="returnApplyDetailResultMap" type="com.macro.mall.dto.OmsOrderReturnApplyResult" extends="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderReturnApplyMapper.BaseResultMap">
 5 |         <association property="companyAddress" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsCompanyAddressMapper.BaseResultMap" columnPrefix="ca_"/>
 6 |     </resultMap>
 7 |     <select id="getList" resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderReturnApplyMapper.BaseResultMap">
 8 |         SELECT
 9 |         id,
10 |         create_time,
11 |         member_username,
12 |         product_real_price,
13 |         product_count,
14 |         return_name,
15 |         status,
16 |         handle_time
17 |         FROM
18 |         oms_order_return_apply
19 |         WHERE
20 |         1 = 1
21 |         <if test="queryParam.id!=null">
22 |             AND id = #{queryParam.id}
23 |         </if>
24 |         <if test="queryParam.status!=null">
25 |             AND status = #{queryParam.status}
26 |         </if>
27 |         <if test="queryParam.status!=null">
28 |             AND status = #{queryParam.status}
29 |         </if>
30 |         <if test="queryParam.handleMan!=null and queryParam.handleMan!=''">
31 |             AND handle_man = #{queryParam.handleMan}
32 |         </if>
33 |         <if test="queryParam.createTime!=null and queryParam.createTime!=''">
34 |             AND create_time LIKE CONCAT(#{queryParam.createTime}, '%')
35 |         </if>
36 |         <if test="queryParam.handleTime!=null and queryParam.handleTime!=''">
37 |             AND handle_time LIKE CONCAT(#{queryParam.handleTime}, '%')
38 |         </if>
39 |         <if test="queryParam.receiverKeyword!=null and queryParam.receiverKeyword!=''">
40 |             AND (return_name LIKE concat("%",#{queryParam.receiverKeyword},"%")
41 |             OR return_phone LIKE concat("%",#{queryParam.receiverKeyword},"%"))
42 |         </if>
43 |     </select>
44 |     <select id="getDetail" resultMap="returnApplyDetailResultMap">
45 |         SELECT
46 |             ra.*, ca.id ca_id,
47 |                   ca.address_name ca_address_name,
48 |                   ca.`name` ca_name,
49 |                   ca.phone ca_phone,
50 |                   ca.province ca_province,
51 |                   ca.city ca_city,
52 |                   ca.region ca_region,
53 |                   ca.detail_address ca_detail_address
54 |         FROM
55 |             oms_order_return_apply ra
56 |             LEFT JOIN oms_company_address ca ON ra.company_address_id = ca.id
57 |         WHERE ra.id=#{id};
58 |     </select>
59 | </mapper>
```

```java
 1 | package com.macro.mall.validator;
 2 | 
 3 | import jakarta.validation.ConstraintValidator;
 4 | import jakarta.validation.ConstraintValidatorContext;
 5 | 
 6 | /**
 7 |  * 状态标记校验器
 8 |  * Created by macro on 2018/4/26.
 9 |  */
10 | public class FlagValidatorClass implements ConstraintValidator<FlagValidator,Integer> {
11 |     private String[] values;
12 |     @Override
13 |     public void initialize(FlagValidator flagValidator) {
14 |         this.values = flagValidator.value();
15 |     }
16 | 
17 |     @Override
18 |     public boolean isValid(Integer value, ConstraintValidatorContext constraintValidatorContext) {
19 |         boolean isValid = false;
20 |         if(value==null){
21 |             //当状态为空时使用默认值
22 |             return true;
23 |         }
24 |         for(int i=0;i<values.length;i++){
25 |             if(values[i].equals(String.valueOf(value))){
26 |                 isValid = true;
27 |                 break;
28 |             }
29 |         }
30 |         return isValid;
31 |     }
32 | }
```

```java
 8 | import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.security.SecurityRequirement;

10 | import org.springdoc.core.customizers.GlobalOpenApiCustomizer;
11 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
12 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

17 |  * SpringDoc相关配置

20 | @Configuration

23 |     private static final String SECURITY_SCHEME_NAME = "Authorization";
24 | 
25 |     @Bean
26 |     public OpenAPI mallAdminOpenAPI() {
27 |         return new OpenAPI()
28 |                 .info(new Info().title("mall后台系统")
29 |                         .description("mall后台相关接口文档")
30 |                         .version("v1.0.0")
31 |                         .license(new License().name("Apache 2.0")
32 |                                 .url("https://github.com/macrozheng/mall-learning")))
33 |                 .externalDocs(new ExternalDocumentation()
34 |                         .description("SpringBoot实战电商项目mall（60K+Star）全套文档")
35 |                         .url("http://www.macrozheng.com"))
36 |                 .addSecurityItem(new SecurityRequirement().addList(SECURITY_SCHEME_NAME))
37 |                 .components(new Components()
38 |                         .addSecuritySchemes(SECURITY_SCHEME_NAME,
39 |                                 new SecurityScheme()
40 |                                         .name(SECURITY_SCHEME_NAME)
41 |                                         .type(SecurityScheme.Type.HTTP)
42 |                                         .scheme("bearer")
43 |                                         .bearerFormat("JWT")));
44 |     }
45 | 
46 |     @Override
47 |     public void addViewControllers(ViewControllerRegistry registry) {
48 |         //配置访问`/swagger-ui/`路径时可以直接跳转到`/swagger-ui/index.html`
49 |         registry.addViewController("/swagger-ui/").setViewName("redirect:/swagger-ui/index.html");
50 |     }
51 | 
52 |     @Bean
53 |     public GlobalOpenApiCustomizer orderGlobalOpenApiCustomizer() {
54 |         //解决Knife4j配置认证后无法自动添加认证头的问题
55 |         return openApi -> {
56 |             //全局添加鉴权参数
57 |             if (openApi.getPaths() != null) {
58 |                 openApi.getPaths().forEach((s, pathItem) -> {
59 |                     pathItem.readOperations().forEach(operation -> {
60 |                         operation.addSecurityItem(new SecurityRequirement().addList(SECURITY_SCHEME_NAME));
61 |                     });
62 |                 });
63 |             }
64 |         };
65 |     }
66 | 
67 | }
68 |
```

```java
  1 | package com.macro.mall.controller;
  2 | 
  3 | import cn.hutool.core.collection.CollUtil;
  4 | import cn.hutool.json.JSONUtil;
  5 | import com.macro.mall.common.api.CommonResult;
  6 | import com.macro.mall.dto.BucketPolicyConfigDto;
  7 | import com.macro.mall.dto.MinioUploadDto;
  8 | import io.minio.*;
  9 | 
 10 | import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
 11 | import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
 12 | import org.slf4j.Logger;
 13 | import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 14 | import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
 15 | import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
 16 | import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
 17 | import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
 18 | 
 19 | import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
 20 | import java.util.Date;
 21 | 
 22 | /**
 23 |  * MinIO对象存储管理
 24 |  * Created by macro on 2019/12/25.
 25 |  */
 26 | @Tag(name = "MinioController", description = "MinIO对象存储管理")
 27 | @Controller
 28 | @RequestMapping("/minio")
 29 | public class MinioController {
 30 | 
 31 |     private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MinioController.class);
 32 |     @Value("${minio.endpoint}")
 33 |     private String ENDPOINT;
 34 |     @Value("${minio.bucketName}")
 35 |     private String BUCKET_NAME;
 36 |     @Value("${minio.accessKey}")
 37 |     private String ACCESS_KEY;
 38 |     @Value("${minio.secretKey}")
 39 |     private String SECRET_KEY;
 40 | 
 41 |     @Operation(summary = "文件上传")
 42 |     @RequestMapping(value = "/upload", method = RequestMethod.POST)
 43 |     @ResponseBody
 44 |     public CommonResult upload(@RequestPart("file") MultipartFile file) {
 45 |         try {
 46 |             //创建一个MinIO的Java客户端
 47 |             MinioClient minioClient =MinioClient.builder()
 48 |                     .endpoint(ENDPOINT)
 49 |                     .credentials(ACCESS_KEY,SECRET_KEY)
 50 |                     .build();
 51 |             boolean isExist = minioClient.bucketExists(BucketExistsArgs.builder().bucket(BUCKET_NAME).build());
 52 |             if (isExist) {
 53 |                 LOGGER.info("存储桶已经存在！");
 54 |             } else {
 55 |                 //创建存储桶并设置只读权限
 56 |                 minioClient.makeBucket(MakeBucketArgs.builder().bucket(BUCKET_NAME).build());
 57 |                 BucketPolicyConfigDto bucketPolicyConfigDto = createBucketPolicyConfigDto(BUCKET_NAME);
 58 |                 SetBucketPolicyArgs setBucketPolicyArgs = SetBucketPolicyArgs.builder()
 59 |                         .bucket(BUCKET_NAME)
 60 |                         .config(JSONUtil.toJsonStr(bucketPolicyConfigDto))
 61 |                         .build();
 62 |                 minioClient.setBucketPolicy(setBucketPolicyArgs);
 63 |             }
 64 |             String filename = file.getOriginalFilename();
 65 |             SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd");
 66 |             // 设置存储对象名称
 67 |             String objectName = sdf.format(new Date()) + "/" + filename;
 68 |             // 使用putObject上传一个文件到存储桶中
 69 |             PutObjectArgs putObjectArgs = PutObjectArgs.builder()
 70 |                     .bucket(BUCKET_NAME)
 71 |                     .object(objectName)
 72 |                     .contentType(file.getContentType())
 73 |                     .stream(file.getInputStream(), file.getSize(), ObjectWriteArgs.MIN_MULTIPART_SIZE).build();
 74 |             minioClient.putObject(putObjectArgs);
 75 |             LOGGER.info("文件上传成功!");
 76 |             MinioUploadDto minioUploadDto = new MinioUploadDto();
 77 |             minioUploadDto.setName(filename);
 78 |             minioUploadDto.setUrl(ENDPOINT + "/" + BUCKET_NAME + "/" + objectName);
 79 |             return CommonResult.success(minioUploadDto);
 80 |         } catch (Exception e) {
 81 |             e.printStackTrace();
 82 |             LOGGER.info("上传发生错误: {}！", e.getMessage());
 83 |         }
 84 |         return CommonResult.failed();
 85 |     }
 86 | 
 87 |     private BucketPolicyConfigDto createBucketPolicyConfigDto(String bucketName) {
 88 |         BucketPolicyConfigDto.Statement statement = BucketPolicyConfigDto.Statement.builder()
 89 |                 .Effect("Allow")
 90 |                 .Principal("*")
 91 |                 .Action("s3:GetObject")
 92 |                 .Resource("arn:aws:s3:::"+bucketName+"/*.**").build();
 93 |         return BucketPolicyConfigDto.builder()
 94 |                 .Version("2012-10-17")
 95 |                 .Statement(CollUtil.toList(statement))
 96 |                 .build();
 97 |     }
 98 | 
 99 |     @Operation(summary = "文件删除")
100 |     @RequestMapping(value = "/delete", method = RequestMethod.POST)
101 |     @ResponseBody
102 |     public CommonResult delete(@RequestParam("objectName") String objectName) {
103 |         try {
104 |             MinioClient minioClient = MinioClient.builder()
105 |                     .endpoint(ENDPOINT)
106 |                     .credentials(ACCESS_KEY,SECRET_KEY)
107 |                     .build();
108 |             minioClient.removeObject(RemoveObjectArgs.builder().bucket(BUCKET_NAME).object(objectName).build());
109 |             return CommonResult.success(null);
110 |         } catch (Exception e) {
111 |             e.printStackTrace();
112 |         }
113 |         return CommonResult.failed();
114 |     }
115 | }
```

```java
 12 | import org.slf4j.Logger;
 13 | import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 14 | import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 15 | import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
 16 | import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 17 | 
 18 | import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 19 | import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
 20 | import java.util.Date;
 21 | 
 22 | /**
 23 |  * oss上传管理Service实现类
 24 |  * Created by macro on 2018/5/17.
 25 |  */
 26 | @Service
 27 | public class OssServiceImpl implements OssService {
 28 | 
 29 | 	private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(OssServiceImpl.class);
 30 | 	@Value("${aliyun.oss.policy.expire}")
 31 | 	private int ALIYUN_OSS_EXPIRE;
 32 | 	@Value("${aliyun.oss.maxSize}")
 33 | 	private int ALIYUN_OSS_MAX_SIZE;
 34 | 	@Value("${aliyun.oss.callback}")
 35 | 	private String ALIYUN_OSS_CALLBACK;
 36 | 	@Value("${aliyun.oss.bucketName}")
 37 | 	private String ALIYUN_OSS_BUCKET_NAME;
 38 | 	@Value("${aliyun.oss.endpoint}")
 39 | 	private String ALIYUN_OSS_ENDPOINT;
 40 | 	@Value("${aliyun.oss.dir.prefix}")
 41 | 	private String ALIYUN_OSS_DIR_PREFIX;
 42 | 
 43 | 	@Autowired
 44 | 	private OSSClient ossClient;
 45 | 
 46 | 	/**
 47 | 	 * 签名生成
 48 | 	 */
 49 | 	@Override
 50 | 	public OssPolicyResult policy() {
 51 | 		OssPolicyResult result = new OssPolicyResult();
 52 | 		// 存储目录
 53 | 		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd");
 54 | 		String dir = ALIYUN_OSS_DIR_PREFIX+sdf.format(new Date());
 55 | 		// 签名有效期
 56 | 		long expireEndTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + ALIYUN_OSS_EXPIRE * 1000;
 57 | 		Date expiration = new Date(expireEndTime);
 58 | 		// 文件大小
 59 | 		long maxSize = ALIYUN_OSS_MAX_SIZE * 1024 * 1024;
 60 | 		// 回调
 61 | 		OssCallbackParam callback = new OssCallbackParam();
 62 | 		callback.setCallbackUrl(ALIYUN_OSS_CALLBACK);
 63 | 		callback.setCallbackBody("filename=${object}&size=${size}&mimeType=${mimeType}&height=${imageInfo.height}&width=${imageInfo.width}");
 64 | 		callback.setCallbackBodyType("application/x-www-form-urlencoded");
 65 | 		// 提交节点
 66 | 		String action = "http://" + ALIYUN_OSS_BUCKET_NAME + "." + ALIYUN_OSS_ENDPOINT;
 67 | 		try {
 68 | 			PolicyConditions policyConds = new PolicyConditions();
 69 | 			policyConds.addConditionItem(PolicyConditions.COND_CONTENT_LENGTH_RANGE, 0, maxSize);
 70 | 			policyConds.addConditionItem(MatchMode.StartWith, PolicyConditions.COND_KEY, dir);
 71 | 			String postPolicy = ossClient.generatePostPolicy(expiration, policyConds);
 72 | 			byte[] binaryData = postPolicy.getBytes("utf-8");
 73 | 			String policy = BinaryUtil.toBase64String(binaryData);
 74 | 			String signature = ossClient.calculatePostSignature(postPolicy);
 75 | 			String callbackData = BinaryUtil.toBase64String(JSONUtil.parse(callback).toString().getBytes("utf-8"));
 76 | 			// 返回结果
 77 | 			result.setAccessKeyId(ossClient.getCredentialsProvider().getCredentials().getAccessKeyId());
 78 | 			result.setPolicy(policy);
 79 | 			result.setSignature(signature);
 80 | 			result.setDir(dir);
 81 | 			result.setCallback(callbackData);
 82 | 			result.setHost(action);
 83 | 		} catch (Exception e) {
 84 | 			LOGGER.error("签名生成失败", e);
 85 | 		}
 86 | 		return result;
 87 | 	}
 88 | 
 89 | 	@Override
 90 | 	public OssCallbackResult callback(HttpServletRequest request) {
 91 | 		OssCallbackResult result= new OssCallbackResult();
 92 | 		String filename = request.getParameter("filename");
 93 | 		filename = "http://".concat(ALIYUN_OSS_BUCKET_NAME).concat(".").concat(ALIYUN_OSS_ENDPOINT).concat("/").concat(filename);
 94 | 		result.setFilename(filename);
 95 | 		result.setSize(request.getParameter("size"));
 96 | 		result.setMimeType(request.getParameter("mimeType"));
 97 | 		result.setWidth(request.getParameter("width"));
 98 | 		result.setHeight(request.getParameter("height"));
 99 | 		return result;
100 | 	}
101 | 
102 | }
```

```java
163 |     private void handleUpdateSkuStockList(Long id, PmsProductParam productParam) {
164 |         //当前的sku信息
165 |         List<PmsSkuStock> currSkuList = productParam.getSkuStockList();
166 |         //当前没有sku直接删除
167 |         if(CollUtil.isEmpty(currSkuList)){
168 |             PmsSkuStockExample skuStockExample = new PmsSkuStockExample();
169 |             skuStockExample.createCriteria().andProductIdEqualTo(id);
170 |             skuStockMapper.deleteByExample(skuStockExample);

172 |         }
173 |         //获取初始sku信息
174 |         PmsSkuStockExample skuStockExample = new PmsSkuStockExample();
175 |         skuStockExample.createCriteria().andProductIdEqualTo(id);
176 |         List<PmsSkuStock> oriStuList = skuStockMapper.selectByExample(skuStockExample);
177 |         //获取新增sku信息
178 |         List<PmsSkuStock> insertSkuList = currSkuList.stream().filter(item->item.getId()==null).collect(Collectors.toList());
179 |         //获取需要更新的sku信息
180 |         List<PmsSkuStock> updateSkuList = currSkuList.stream().filter(item->item.getId()!=null).collect(Collectors.toList());
181 |         List<Long> updateSkuIds = updateSkuList.stream().map(PmsSkuStock::getId).collect(Collectors.toList());
182 |         //获取需要删除的sku信息
183 |         List<PmsSkuStock> removeSkuList = oriStuList.stream().filter(item-> !updateSkuIds.contains(item.getId())).collect(Collectors.toList());
184 |         handleSkuStockCode(insertSkuList,id);
185 |         handleSkuStockCode(updateSkuList,id);
186 |         //新增sku
187 |         if(CollUtil.isNotEmpty(insertSkuList)){
188 |             relateAndInsertList(skuStockDao, insertSkuList, id);

193 |             PmsSkuStockExample removeExample = new PmsSkuStockExample();
194 |             removeExample.createCriteria().andIdIn(removeSkuIds);
195 |             skuStockMapper.deleteByExample(removeExample);
196 |         }
197 |         //修改sku
198 |         if(CollUtil.isNotEmpty(updateSkuList)){
199 |             for (PmsSkuStock pmsSkuStock : updateSkuList) {
200 |                 skuStockMapper.updateByPrimaryKeySelective(pmsSkuStock);
201 |             }
202 |         }
```

```java
  1 | package com.macro.mall.service.impl;
```

```java
  3 | import com.github.pagehelper.PageHelper;
  4 | import com.macro.mall.dto.UmsMenuNode;
  5 | import com.macro.mall.mapper.UmsMenuMapper;
  6 | import com.macro.mall.model.*;
  7 | import com.macro.mall.service.UmsMenuService;
  8 | import org.springframework.beans.BeanUtils;
  9 | import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 10 | import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 11 | 
 12 | import java.util.Date;
 13 | import java.util.List;
 14 | import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 15 | 
 16 | /**
 17 |  * 后台菜单管理Service实现类
 18 |  * Created by macro on 2020/2/2.
 19 |  */
 20 | @Service
 21 | public class UmsMenuServiceImpl implements UmsMenuService {
 22 |     @Autowired
 23 |     private UmsMenuMapper menuMapper;
 24 | 
 25 |     @Override
 26 |     public int create(UmsMenu umsMenu) {
 27 |         umsMenu.setCreateTime(new Date());
 28 |         updateLevel(umsMenu);
 29 |         return menuMapper.insert(umsMenu);
 30 |     }
 31 | 
 32 |     /**
 33 |      * 修改菜单层级
 34 |      */
 35 |     private void updateLevel(UmsMenu umsMenu) {
 36 |         if (umsMenu.getParentId() == 0) {
 37 |             //没有父菜单时为一级菜单
 38 |             umsMenu.setLevel(0);
 39 |         } else {
 40 |             //有父菜单时选择根据父菜单level设置
 41 |             UmsMenu parentMenu = menuMapper.selectByPrimaryKey(umsMenu.getParentId());
 42 |             if (parentMenu != null) {
 43 |                 umsMenu.setLevel(parentMenu.getLevel() + 1);
 44 |             } else {
 45 |                 umsMenu.setLevel(0);
 46 |             }
 47 |         }
 48 |     }
 49 | 
 50 |     @Override
 51 |     public int update(Long id, UmsMenu umsMenu) {
 52 |         umsMenu.setId(id);
 53 |         updateLevel(umsMenu);
 54 |         return menuMapper.updateByPrimaryKeySelective(umsMenu);
 55 |     }
 56 | 
 57 |     @Override
 58 |     public UmsMenu getItem(Long id) {
 59 |         return menuMapper.selectByPrimaryKey(id);
 60 |     }
 61 | 
 62 |     @Override
 63 |     public int delete(Long id) {
 64 |         return menuMapper.deleteByPrimaryKey(id);
 65 |     }
 66 | 
 67 |     @Override
 68 |     public List<UmsMenu> list(Long parentId, Integer pageSize, Integer pageNum) {
 69 |         PageHelper.startPage(pageNum, pageSize);
 70 |         UmsMenuExample example = new UmsMenuExample();
 71 |         example.setOrderByClause("sort desc");
 72 |         example.createCriteria().andParentIdEqualTo(parentId);
 73 |         return menuMapper.selectByExample(example);
 74 |     }
 75 | 
 76 |     @Override
 77 |     public List<UmsMenuNode> treeList() {
 78 |         List<UmsMenu> menuList = menuMapper.selectByExample(new UmsMenuExample());
 79 |         List<UmsMenuNode> result = menuList.stream()
 80 |                 .filter(menu -> menu.getParentId().equals(0L))
 81 |                 .map(menu -> covertMenuNode(menu, menuList)).collect(Collectors.toList());
 82 |         return result;
 83 |     }
 84 | 
 85 |     @Override
 86 |     public int updateHidden(Long id, Integer hidden) {
 87 |         UmsMenu umsMenu = new UmsMenu();
 88 |         umsMenu.setId(id);
 89 |         umsMenu.setHidden(hidden);
 90 |         return menuMapper.updateByPrimaryKeySelective(umsMenu);
 91 |     }
 92 | 
 93 |     /**
 94 |      * 将UmsMenu转化为UmsMenuNode并设置children属性
 95 |      */
 96 |     private UmsMenuNode covertMenuNode(UmsMenu menu, List<UmsMenu> menuList) {
 97 |         UmsMenuNode node = new UmsMenuNode();
 98 |         BeanUtils.copyProperties(menu, node);
 99 |         List<UmsMenuNode> children = menuList.stream()
100 |                 .filter(subMenu -> subMenu.getParentId().equals(menu.getId()))
101 |                 .map(subMenu -> covertMenuNode(subMenu, menuList)).collect(Collectors.toList());
102 |         node.setChildren(children);
103 |         return node;
104 |     }
105 | }
```

```xml
31 |         </jdbcConnection>
32 |

38 |                              targetProject="mall-mbg\src\main\java"/>

40 |         <table tableName="%">
41 |             <generatedKey column="id" sqlStatement="MySql" identity="true"/>
42 |         </table>
43 |     </context>
44 | </generatorConfiguration>
```

```java
 1 | package com.macro.mall;
 2 | 
 3 | import org.mybatis.generator.api.IntrospectedColumn;
 4 | import org.mybatis.generator.api.IntrospectedTable;
 5 | import org.mybatis.generator.api.dom.java.CompilationUnit;
 6 | import org.mybatis.generator.api.dom.java.Field;
 7 | import org.mybatis.generator.api.dom.java.FullyQualifiedJavaType;
 8 | import org.mybatis.generator.internal.DefaultCommentGenerator;
 9 | import org.mybatis.generator.internal.util.StringUtility;
10 | 
11 | import java.util.Properties;
12 | 
13 | /**
14 |  * 自定义注释生成器
15 |  * Created by macro on 2018/4/26.
16 |  */
17 | public class CommentGenerator extends DefaultCommentGenerator {
18 |     private boolean addRemarkComments = false;
19 |     private static final String EXAMPLE_SUFFIX="Example";
20 |     private static final String MAPPER_SUFFIX="Mapper";
21 |     private static final String API_MODEL_PROPERTY_FULL_CLASS_NAME="io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema";
22 | 
23 |     /**
24 |      * 设置用户配置的参数
25 |      */
26 |     @Override
27 |     public void addConfigurationProperties(Properties properties) {
28 |         super.addConfigurationProperties(properties);
29 |         this.addRemarkComments = StringUtility.isTrue(properties.getProperty("addRemarkComments"));
30 |     }
31 | 
32 |     /**
33 |      * 给字段添加注释
34 |      */
35 |     @Override
36 |     public void addFieldComment(Field field, IntrospectedTable introspectedTable,
37 |                                 IntrospectedColumn introspectedColumn) {
38 |         String remarks = introspectedColumn.getRemarks();
39 |         //根据参数和备注信息判断是否添加swagger注解信息
40 |         if(addRemarkComments&&StringUtility.stringHasValue(remarks)){
41 | //            addFieldJavaDoc(field, remarks);
42 |             //数据库中特殊字符需要转义
43 |             if(remarks.contains("\"")){
44 |                 remarks = remarks.replace("\"","'");
45 |             }
46 |             //给model的字段添加swagger注解
47 |             field.addJavaDocLine("@Schema(title = \""+remarks+"\")");
48 |         }
49 |     }
50 | 
51 |     /**
52 |      * 给model的字段添加注释
53 |      */
54 |     private void addFieldJavaDoc(Field field, String remarks) {
55 |         //文档注释开始
56 |         field.addJavaDocLine("/**");
57 |         //获取数据库字段的备注信息
58 |         String[] remarkLines = remarks.split(System.getProperty("line.separator"));
59 |         for(String remarkLine:remarkLines){
60 |             field.addJavaDocLine(" * "+remarkLine);
61 |         }
62 |         addJavadocTag(field, false);
63 |         field.addJavaDocLine(" */");
64 |     }
65 | 
66 |     @Override
67 |     public void addJavaFileComment(CompilationUnit compilationUnit) {
68 |         super.addJavaFileComment(compilationUnit);
69 |         //只在model中添加swagger注解类的导入
70 |         if(!compilationUnit.getType().getFullyQualifiedName().contains(MAPPER_SUFFIX)&&!compilationUnit.getType().getFullyQualifiedName().contains(EXAMPLE_SUFFIX)){
71 |             compilationUnit.addImportedType(new FullyQualifiedJavaType(API_MODEL_PROPERTY_FULL_CLASS_NAME));
72 |         }
73 |     }
74 | }
```

```java
 1 | package com.macro.mall;
 2 | 
 3 | import org.mybatis.generator.api.MyBatisGenerator;
 4 | import org.mybatis.generator.config.Configuration;
 5 | import org.mybatis.generator.config.xml.ConfigurationParser;
 6 | import org.mybatis.generator.internal.DefaultShellCallback;
 7 | 
 8 | import java.io.InputStream;
 9 | import java.util.ArrayList;
10 | import java.util.List;
11 | 
12 | /**
13 |  * 用于生产MBG的代码
14 |  * Created by macro on 2018/4/26.
15 |  */
16 | public class Generator {
17 |     public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
18 |         //MBG 执行过程中的警告信息
19 |         List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<String>();
20 |         //当生成的代码重复时，覆盖原代码
21 |         boolean overwrite = true;
22 |         //读取我们的 MBG 配置文件
23 |         InputStream is = Generator.class.getResourceAsStream("/generatorConfig.xml");
24 |         ConfigurationParser cp = new ConfigurationParser(warnings);
25 |         Configuration config = cp.parseConfiguration(is);
26 |         is.close();
27 | 
28 |         DefaultShellCallback callback = new DefaultShellCallback(overwrite);
29 |         //创建 MBG
30 |         MyBatisGenerator myBatisGenerator = new MyBatisGenerator(config, callback, warnings);
31 |         //执行生成代码
32 |         myBatisGenerator.generate(null);
33 |         //输出警告信息
34 |         for (String warning : warnings) {
35 |             System.out.println(warning);
36 |         }
37 |     }
38 | }
```

```xml
 1 | <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
 2 | <!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
 3 | <mapper namespace="com.macro.mall.portal.dao.PortalOrderDao">
 4 |     <resultMap id="orderDetailMap" type="com.macro.mall.portal.domain.OmsOrderDetail"
 5 |                extends="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderMapper.BaseResultMap">
 6 |         <collection property="orderItemList" columnPrefix="ot_"
 7 |                     resultMap="com.macro.mall.mapper.OmsOrderItemMapper.BaseResultMap">
 8 |         </collection>
 9 |     </resultMap>
10 |     <select id="getDetail" resultMap="orderDetailMap">
11 |         SELECT
12 |             o.id,
13 |             o.order_sn,
14 |             o.coupon_id,
15 |             o.integration,
16 |             o.member_id,
17 |             ot.id ot_id,
18 |             ot.product_name ot_product_name,
19 |             ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id,
20 |             ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code,
21 |             ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity
22 |         FROM
23 |             oms_order o
24 |             LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id
25 |         WHERE
26 |             o.id = #{orderId}
27 |     </select>
28 | 
29 |     <select id="getTimeOutOrders" resultMap="orderDetailMap">
30 |         SELECT
31 |             o.id,
32 |             o.order_sn,
33 |             o.coupon_id,
34 |             o.integration,
35 |             o.member_id,
36 |             o.use_integration,
37 |             ot.id               ot_id,
38 |             ot.product_name     ot_product_name,
39 |             ot.product_sku_id   ot_product_sku_id,
40 |             ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code,
41 |             ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity
42 |         FROM
43 |             oms_order o
44 |             LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id
45 |         WHERE
46 |             o.status = 0
47 |             AND o.create_time &lt; date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -#{minute} MINUTE);
48 |     </select>
49 | 
50 |     <update id="updateSkuStock">
51 |         UPDATE pms_sku_stock
52 |         SET
53 |             stock = CASE id
54 |             <foreach collection="itemList" item="item">
55 |               WHEN #{item.productSkuId} THEN stock - #{item.productQuantity}
56 |             </foreach>
57 |             END,
58 |             lock_stock = CASE id
59 |             <foreach collection="itemList" item="item">
60 |               WHEN #{item.productSkuId} THEN lock_stock - #{item.productQuantity}
61 |             </foreach>
62 |             END
63 |         WHERE
64 |             id IN
65 |         <foreach collection="itemList" item="item" separator="," open="(" close=")">
66 |             #{item.productSkuId}
67 |         </foreach>
68 |     </update>
69 |     <update id="updateOrderStatus">
70 |         update oms_order
71 |         set status=#{status}
72 |         where id in
73 |         <foreach collection="ids" item="id" separator="," open="(" close=")">
74 |             #{id}
75 |         </foreach>
76 |     </update>
77 |     <update id="releaseSkuStockLock">
78 |         UPDATE pms_sku_stock
79 |         SET
80 |         lock_stock = CASE id
81 |         <foreach collection="itemList" item="item">
82 |             WHEN #{item.productSkuId} THEN lock_stock - #{item.productQuantity}
83 |         </foreach>
84 |         END
85 |         WHERE
86 |         id IN
87 |         <foreach collection="itemList" item="item" separator="," open="(" close=")">
88 |             #{item.productSkuId}
89 |         </foreach>
90 |     </update>
91 | </mapper>
```

```xml
 14 |         </collection>

 18 |         </collection>

 24 |             p.sub_title subTitle,
 25 |             p.price price,

 31 |             ps.id sku_id,
 32 |             ps.sku_code sku_code,
 33 |             ps.price sku_price,
 34 |             ps.stock sku_stock,
 35 |             ps.pic sku_pic
 36 |         FROM
 37 |             pms_product p
 38 |             LEFT JOIN pms_product_attribute pa ON p.product_attribute_category_id = pa.product_attribute_category_id
 39 |             LEFT JOIN pms_sku_stock ps ON p.id=ps.product_id
 40 |         WHERE

 42 |             AND pa.type = 0
 43 |         ORDER BY pa.sort desc
 44 |     </select>

 67 |             LEFT JOIN pms_product_ladder ladder ON p.id = ladder.product_id
 68 |             LEFT JOIN pms_product_full_reduction full_re ON p.id = full_re.product_id
 69 |         WHERE

 72 |             #{id}
 73 |         </foreach>
```

```xml
25 |         WHERE

45 |         WHERE

52 |         SET

56 |             </foreach>
57 |             END,

60 |               WHEN #{item.productSkuId} THEN lock_stock - #{item.productQuantity}
61 |             </foreach>
62 |             END
63 |         WHERE

66 |             #{item.productSkuId}
67 |         </foreach>
```

```xml
 39 |             LEFT JOIN pms_sku_stock ps ON p.id=ps.product_id
 40 |         WHERE
```

```java
 6 | /**
 7 |  * 日期工具类

10 | public class DateUtil {

12 |     /**
13 |      * 从Date类型的时间中提取日期部分
14 |      */
15 |     public static Date getDate(Date date) {
16 |         Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
17 |         calendar.setTime(date);
18 |         calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
19 |         calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
20 |         calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
21 |         return calendar.getTime();
22 |     }
23 | 
24 |     /**
25 |      * 从Date类型的时间中提取时间部分
26 |      */
27 |     public static Date getTime(Date date) {
28 |         Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
29 |         calendar.setTime(date);
30 |         calendar.set(Calendar.YEAR, 1970);
31 |         calendar.set(Calendar.MONTH, 0);
32 |         calendar.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
33 |         return calendar.getTime();
34 |     }
35 | }
```

```java
 6 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 7 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

12 | /**
13 |  * Jackson相关配置类
14 |  * json不返回null的字段
15 |  * Created by macro on 2018/8/2.
16 |  */
17 | @Configuration
18 | public class JacksonConfig {
19 |     @Bean
20 |     @Primary
21 |     @ConditionalOnMissingBean(ObjectMapper.class)
22 |     public ObjectMapper jacksonObjectMapper(Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder builder) {
23 |         ObjectMapper objectMapper = builder.createXmlMapper(false).build();
24 | 
25 |         // 通过该方法对mapper对象进行设置，所有序列化的对象都将按改规则进行系列化
26 |         // Include.Include.ALWAYS 默认
27 |         // Include.NON_DEFAULT 属性为默认值不序列化
28 |         // Include.NON_EMPTY 属性为 空（""） 或者为 NULL 都不序列化，则返回的json是没有这个字段的。这样对移动端会更省流量
29 |         // Include.NON_NULL 属性为NULL 不序列化,就是为null的字段不参加序列化
30 |         objectMapper.setSerializationInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL);
31 | 
32 |         // 字段保留，将null值转为""
33 | //        objectMapper.getSerializerProvider().setNullValueSerializer(new JsonSerializer<Object>()

35 | //            @Override

37 | //                                  SerializerProvider serializerProvider)
38 | //                    throws IOException, JsonProcessingException
39 | //            {
40 | //                jsonGenerator.writeString("");
41 | //            }
42 | //        });
43 |         return objectMapper;
44 |     }
45 | }
```

```java
 1 | package com.macro.mall.portal.config;
 2 | 
 3 | import com.macro.mall.portal.domain.QueueEnum;
 4 | import org.springframework.amqp.core.*;
 5 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 6 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
 7 | 
 8 | /**
 9 |  * 消息队列相关配置
10 |  * Created by macro on 2018/9/14.
11 |  */
12 | @Configuration
13 | public class RabbitMqConfig {
14 | 
15 |     /**
16 |      * 订单消息实际消费队列所绑定的交换机
17 |      */
18 |     @Bean
19 |     DirectExchange orderDirect() {
20 |         return (DirectExchange) ExchangeBuilder
21 |                 .directExchange(QueueEnum.QUEUE_ORDER_CANCEL.getExchange())
22 |                 .durable(true)
23 |                 .build();
24 |     }
25 | 
26 |     /**
27 |      * 订单延迟队列队列所绑定的交换机
28 |      */
29 |     @Bean
30 |     DirectExchange orderTtlDirect() {
31 |         return (DirectExchange) ExchangeBuilder
32 |                 .directExchange(QueueEnum.QUEUE_TTL_ORDER_CANCEL.getExchange())
33 |                 .durable(true)
34 |                 .build();
35 |     }
36 | 
37 |     /**
38 |      * 订单实际消费队列
39 |      */
40 |     @Bean
41 |     public Queue orderQueue() {
42 |         return new Queue(QueueEnum.QUEUE_ORDER_CANCEL.getName());
43 |     }
44 | 
45 |     /**
46 |      * 订单延迟队列（死信队列）
47 |      */
48 |     @Bean
49 |     public Queue orderTtlQueue() {
50 |         return QueueBuilder
51 |                 .durable(QueueEnum.QUEUE_TTL_ORDER_CANCEL.getName())
52 |                 .withArgument("x-dead-letter-exchange", QueueEnum.QUEUE_ORDER_CANCEL.getExchange())//到期后转发的交换机
53 |                 .withArgument("x-dead-letter-routing-key", QueueEnum.QUEUE_ORDER_CANCEL.getRouteKey())//到期后转发的路由键
54 |                 .build();
55 |     }
56 | 
57 |     /**
58 |      * 将订单队列绑定到交换机
59 |      */
60 |     @Bean
61 |     Binding orderBinding(DirectExchange orderDirect,Queue orderQueue){
62 |         return BindingBuilder
63 |                 .bind(orderQueue)
64 |                 .to(orderDirect)
65 |                 .with(QueueEnum.QUEUE_ORDER_CANCEL.getRouteKey());
66 |     }
67 | 
68 |     /**
69 |      * 将订单延迟队列绑定到交换机
70 |      */
71 |     @Bean
72 |     Binding orderTtlBinding(DirectExchange orderTtlDirect,Queue orderTtlQueue){
73 |         return BindingBuilder
74 |                 .bind(orderTtlQueue)
75 |                 .to(orderTtlDirect)
76 |                 .with(QueueEnum.QUEUE_TTL_ORDER_CANCEL.getRouteKey());
77 |     }
78 | 
79 | }
```

```java
17 | @Component
18 | public class CancelOrderSender {

20 |     @Autowired
21 |     private AmqpTemplate amqpTemplate;
22 | 
23 |     public void sendMessage(Long orderId,final long delayTimes){
24 |         //给延迟队列发送消息
25 |         amqpTemplate.convertAndSend(QueueEnum.QUEUE_TTL_ORDER_CANCEL.getExchange(), QueueEnum.QUEUE_TTL_ORDER_CANCEL.getRouteKey(), orderId, new MessagePostProcessor() {
26 |             @Override
27 |             public Message postProcessMessage(Message message) throws AmqpException {
28 |                 //给消息设置延迟毫秒值
29 |                 message.getMessageProperties().setExpiration(String.valueOf(delayTimes));
30 |                 return message;
31 |             }
32 |         });
33 |         LOGGER.info("send orderId:{}",orderId);
34 |     }
35 | }
```

```java
 42 |     @Override
 43 |     public void add(Long couponId) {
 44 |         UmsMember currentMember = memberService.getCurrentMember();
 45 |         //获取优惠券信息，判断数量
 46 |         SmsCoupon coupon = couponMapper.selectByPrimaryKey(couponId);
 47 |         if(coupon==null){
 48 |             Asserts.fail("优惠券不存在");
 49 |         }
 50 |         if(coupon.getCount()<=0){
 51 |             Asserts.fail("优惠券已经领完了");
 52 |         }
 53 |         Date now = new Date();
 54 |         if(now.before(coupon.getEnableTime())){
 55 |             Asserts.fail("优惠券还没到领取时间");
 56 |         }
 57 |         //判断用户领取的优惠券数量是否超过限制
 58 |         SmsCouponHistoryExample couponHistoryExample = new SmsCouponHistoryExample();
 59 |         couponHistoryExample.createCriteria().andCouponIdEqualTo(couponId).andMemberIdEqualTo(currentMember.getId());
 60 |         long count = couponHistoryMapper.countByExample(couponHistoryExample);
 61 |         if(count>=coupon.getPerLimit()){
 62 |             Asserts.fail("您已经领取过该优惠券");
 63 |         }
 64 |         //生成领取优惠券历史
 65 |         SmsCouponHistory couponHistory = new SmsCouponHistory();
 66 |         couponHistory.setCouponId(couponId);
 67 |         couponHistory.setCouponCode(generateCouponCode(currentMember.getId()));
 68 |         couponHistory.setCreateTime(now);
 69 |         couponHistory.setMemberId(currentMember.getId());
 70 |         couponHistory.setMemberNickname(currentMember.getNickname());
 71 |         //主动领取
 72 |         couponHistory.setGetType(1);
 73 |         //未使用
 74 |         couponHistory.setUseStatus(0);
 75 |         couponHistoryMapper.insert(couponHistory);
 76 |         //修改优惠券表的数量、领取数量
 77 |         coupon.setCount(coupon.getCount()-1);
 78 |         coupon.setReceiveCount(coupon.getReceiveCount()==null?1:coupon.getReceiveCount()+1);
 79 |         couponMapper.updateByPrimaryKey(coupon);
 80 |     }

 82 |     /**
 83 |      * 16位优惠码生成：时间戳后8位+4位随机数+用户id后4位
 84 |      */
 85 |     private String generateCouponCode(Long memberId) {
 86 |         StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 87 |         Long currentTimeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis();
 88 |         String timeMillisStr = currentTimeMillis.toString();
 89 |         sb.append(timeMillisStr.substring(timeMillisStr.length() - 8));
 90 |         for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
 91 |             sb.append(new Random().nextInt(10));
 92 |         }
 93 |         String memberIdStr = memberId.toString();
 94 |         if (memberIdStr.length() <= 4) {
 95 |             sb.append(String.format("%04d", memberId));
 96 |         } else {
 97 |             sb.append(memberIdStr.substring(memberIdStr.length()-4));
 98 |         }
 99 |         return sb.toString();
100 |     }

114 |     @Override
115 |     public List<SmsCouponHistoryDetail> listCart(List<CartPromotionItem> cartItemList, Integer type) {
116 |         UmsMember currentMember = memberService.getCurrentMember();
117 |         Date now = new Date();
118 |         //获取该用户所有优惠券
119 |         List<SmsCouponHistoryDetail> allList = couponHistoryDao.getDetailList(currentMember.getId());
120 |         //根据优惠券使用类型来判断优惠券是否可用
121 |         List<SmsCouponHistoryDetail> enableList = new ArrayList<>();
122 |         List<SmsCouponHistoryDetail> disableList = new ArrayList<>();
123 |         for (SmsCouponHistoryDetail couponHistoryDetail : allList) {
124 |             Integer useType = couponHistoryDetail.getCoupon().getUseType();
125 |             BigDecimal minPoint = couponHistoryDetail.getCoupon().getMinPoint();
126 |             Date endTime = couponHistoryDetail.getCoupon().getEndTime();
127 |             if(useType.equals(0)){
128 |                 //0->全场通用
129 |                 //判断是否满足优惠起点
130 |                 //计算购物车商品的总价
131 |                 BigDecimal totalAmount = calcTotalAmount(cartItemList);
132 |                 if(now.before(endTime)&&totalAmount.subtract(minPoint).intValue()>=0){
133 |                     enableList.add(couponHistoryDetail);
134 |                 }else{
135 |                     disableList.add(couponHistoryDetail);
136 |                 }
137 |             }else if(useType.equals(1)){
138 |                 //1->指定分类
139 |                 //计算指定分类商品的总价
140 |                 List<Long> productCategoryIds = new ArrayList<>();
141 |                 for (SmsCouponProductCategoryRelation categoryRelation : couponHistoryDetail.getCategoryRelationList()) {
142 |                     productCategoryIds.add(categoryRelation.getProductCategoryId());
143 |                 }
144 |                 BigDecimal totalAmount = calcTotalAmountByproductCategoryId(cartItemList,productCategoryIds);
145 |                 if(now.before(endTime)&&totalAmount.intValue()>0&&totalAmount.subtract(minPoint).intValue()>=0){
146 |                     enableList.add(couponHistoryDetail);
147 |                 }else{
148 |                     disableList.add(couponHistoryDetail);
149 |                 }
150 |             }else if(useType.equals(2)){
151 |                 //2->指定商品
152 |                 //计算指定商品的总价
153 |                 List<Long> productIds = new ArrayList<>();
154 |                 for (SmsCouponProductRelation productRelation : couponHistoryDetail.getProductRelationList()) {
155 |                     productIds.add(productRelation.getProductId());
156 |                 }
157 |                 BigDecimal totalAmount = calcTotalAmountByProductId(cartItemList,productIds);
158 |                 if(now.before(endTime)&&totalAmount.intValue()>0&&totalAmount.subtract(minPoint).intValue()>=0){
159 |                     enableList.add(couponHistoryDetail);
160 |                 }else{
161 |                     disableList.add(couponHistoryDetail);
162 |                 }
163 |             }
164 |         }
165 |         if(type.equals(1)){
166 |             return enableList;
167 |         }else{
168 |             return disableList;
169 |         }
170 |     }

172 |     @Override
173 |     public List<SmsCoupon> listByProduct(Long productId) {
174 |         List<Long> allCouponIds = new ArrayList<>();
175 |         //获取指定商品优惠券
176 |         SmsCouponProductRelationExample cprExample = new SmsCouponProductRelationExample();
177 |         cprExample.createCriteria().andProductIdEqualTo(productId);
178 |         List<SmsCouponProductRelation> cprList = couponProductRelationMapper.selectByExample(cprExample);
179 |         if(CollUtil.isNotEmpty(cprList)){
180 |             List<Long> couponIds = cprList.stream().map(SmsCouponProductRelation::getCouponId).collect(Collectors.toList());
181 |             allCouponIds.addAll(couponIds);
182 |         }
183 |         //获取指定分类优惠券
184 |         PmsProduct product = productMapper.selectByPrimaryKey(productId);
185 |         SmsCouponProductCategoryRelationExample cpcrExample = new SmsCouponProductCategoryRelationExample();
186 |         cpcrExample.createCriteria().andProductCategoryIdEqualTo(product.getProductCategoryId());
187 |         List<SmsCouponProductCategoryRelation> cpcrList = couponProductCategoryRelationMapper.selectByExample(cpcrExample);
188 |         if(CollUtil.isNotEmpty(cpcrList)){
189 |             List<Long> couponIds = cpcrList.stream().map(SmsCouponProductCategoryRelation::getCouponId).collect(Collectors.toList());
190 |             allCouponIds.addAll(couponIds);
191 |         }
192 |         if(CollUtil.isEmpty(allCouponIds)){
193 |             return new ArrayList<>();
194 |         }
195 |         //所有优惠券
196 |         SmsCouponExample couponExample = new SmsCouponExample();
197 |         couponExample.createCriteria().andEndTimeGreaterThan(new Date())
198 |                 .andStartTimeLessThan(new Date())
199 |                 .andUseTypeEqualTo(0);
200 |         couponExample.or(couponExample.createCriteria()
201 |                 .andEndTimeGreaterThan(new Date())
202 |                 .andStartTimeLessThan(new Date())
203 |                 .andUseTypeNotEqualTo(0)
204 |                 .andIdIn(allCouponIds));
205 |         return couponMapper.selectByExample(couponExample);
206 |     }

214 |     private BigDecimal calcTotalAmount(List<CartPromotionItem> cartItemList) {
215 |         BigDecimal total = new BigDecimal("0");
216 |         for (CartPromotionItem item : cartItemList) {
217 |             BigDecimal realPrice = item.getPrice().subtract(item.getReduceAmount());
218 |             total=total.add(realPrice.multiply(new BigDecimal(item.getQuantity())));
219 |         }
220 |         return total;
221 |     }
222 | 
223 |     private BigDecimal calcTotalAmountByproductCategoryId(List<CartPromotionItem> cartItemList,List<Long> productCategoryIds) {
224 |         BigDecimal total = new BigDecimal("0");
225 |         for (CartPromotionItem item : cartItemList) {
226 |             if(productCategoryIds.contains(item.getProductCategoryId())){
227 |                 BigDecimal realPrice = item.getPrice().subtract(item.getReduceAmount());
228 |                 total=total.add(realPrice.multiply(new BigDecimal(item.getQuantity())));
229 |             }
230 |         }
231 |         return total;
232 |     }
233 | 
234 |     private BigDecimal calcTotalAmountByProductId(List<CartPromotionItem> cartItemList,List<Long> productIds) {
235 |         BigDecimal total = new BigDecimal("0");
236 |         for (CartPromotionItem item : cartItemList) {
237 |             if(productIds.contains(item.getProductId())){
238 |                 BigDecimal realPrice = item.getPrice().subtract(item.getReduceAmount());
239 |                 total=total.add(realPrice.multiply(new BigDecimal(item.getQuantity())));
240 |             }
241 |         }
242 |         return total;
243 |     }
```

```java
 29 |     @Override
 30 |     public List<CartPromotionItem> calcCartPromotion(List<OmsCartItem> cartItemList) {
 31 |         //1.先根据productId对CartItem进行分组，以spu为单位进行计算优惠
 32 |         Map<Long, List<OmsCartItem>> productCartMap = groupCartItemBySpu(cartItemList);
 33 |         //2.查询所有商品的优惠相关信息
 34 |         List<PromotionProduct> promotionProductList = getPromotionProductList(cartItemList);
 35 |         //3.根据商品促销类型计算商品促销优惠价格
 36 |         List<CartPromotionItem> cartPromotionItemList = new ArrayList<>();
 37 |         for (Map.Entry<Long, List<OmsCartItem>> entry : productCartMap.entrySet()) {
 38 |             Long productId = entry.getKey();
 39 |             PromotionProduct promotionProduct = getPromotionProductById(productId, promotionProductList);
 40 |             List<OmsCartItem> itemList = entry.getValue();
 41 |             Integer promotionType = promotionProduct.getPromotionType();
 42 |             if (promotionType == 1) {
 43 |                 //单品促销
 44 |                 for (OmsCartItem item : itemList) {
 45 |                     CartPromotionItem cartPromotionItem = new CartPromotionItem();
 46 |                     BeanUtils.copyProperties(item,cartPromotionItem);
 47 |                     cartPromotionItem.setPromotionMessage("单品促销");
 48 |                     //商品原价-促销价
 49 |                     PmsSkuStock skuStock = getOriginalPrice(promotionProduct, item.getProductSkuId());
 50 |                     BigDecimal originalPrice = skuStock.getPrice();
 51 |                     //单品促销使用原价
 52 |                     cartPromotionItem.setPrice(originalPrice);
 53 |                     cartPromotionItem.setReduceAmount(originalPrice.subtract(skuStock.getPromotionPrice()));
 54 |                     cartPromotionItem.setRealStock(skuStock.getStock()-skuStock.getLockStock());
 55 |                     cartPromotionItem.setIntegration(promotionProduct.getGiftPoint());
 56 |                     cartPromotionItem.setGrowth(promotionProduct.getGiftGrowth());
 57 |                     cartPromotionItemList.add(cartPromotionItem);
 58 |                 }
 59 |             } else if (promotionType == 3) {
 60 |                 //打折优惠
 61 |                 int count = getCartItemCount(itemList);
 62 |                 PmsProductLadder ladder = getProductLadder(count, promotionProduct.getProductLadderList());
 63 |                 if(ladder!=null){
 64 |                     for (OmsCartItem item : itemList) {
 65 |                         CartPromotionItem cartPromotionItem = new CartPromotionItem();
 66 |                         BeanUtils.copyProperties(item,cartPromotionItem);
 67 |                         String message = getLadderPromotionMessage(ladder);
 68 |                         cartPromotionItem.setPromotionMessage(message);
 69 |                         //商品原价-折扣*商品原价
 70 |                         PmsSkuStock skuStock = getOriginalPrice(promotionProduct,item.getProductSkuId());
 71 |                         BigDecimal originalPrice = skuStock.getPrice();
 72 |                         BigDecimal reduceAmount = originalPrice.subtract(ladder.getDiscount().multiply(originalPrice));
 73 |                         cartPromotionItem.setReduceAmount(reduceAmount);
 74 |                         cartPromotionItem.setRealStock(skuStock.getStock()-skuStock.getLockStock());
 75 |                         cartPromotionItem.setIntegration(promotionProduct.getGiftPoint());
 76 |                         cartPromotionItem.setGrowth(promotionProduct.getGiftGrowth());
 77 |                         cartPromotionItemList.add(cartPromotionItem);
 78 |                     }
 79 |                 }else{
 80 |                     handleNoReduce(cartPromotionItemList,itemList,promotionProduct);
 81 |                 }
 82 |             } else if (promotionType == 4) {
 83 |                 //满减
 84 |                 BigDecimal totalAmount= getCartItemAmount(itemList,promotionProductList);
 85 |                 PmsProductFullReduction fullReduction = getProductFullReduction(totalAmount,promotionProduct.getProductFullReductionList());
 86 |                 if(fullReduction!=null){
 87 |                     for (OmsCartItem item : itemList) {
 88 |                         CartPromotionItem cartPromotionItem = new CartPromotionItem();
 89 |                         BeanUtils.copyProperties(item,cartPromotionItem);
 90 |                         String message = getFullReductionPromotionMessage(fullReduction);
 91 |                         cartPromotionItem.setPromotionMessage(message);
 92 |                         //(商品原价/总价)*满减金额
 93 |                         PmsSkuStock skuStock= getOriginalPrice(promotionProduct, item.getProductSkuId());
 94 |                         BigDecimal originalPrice = skuStock.getPrice();
 95 |                         BigDecimal reduceAmount = originalPrice.divide(totalAmount,RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN).multiply(fullReduction.getReducePrice());
 96 |                         cartPromotionItem.setReduceAmount(reduceAmount);
 97 |                         cartPromotionItem.setRealStock(skuStock.getStock()-skuStock.getLockStock());
 98 |                         cartPromotionItem.setIntegration(promotionProduct.getGiftPoint());
 99 |                         cartPromotionItem.setGrowth(promotionProduct.getGiftGrowth());
100 |                         cartPromotionItemList.add(cartPromotionItem);
101 |                     }
102 |                 }else{
103 |                     handleNoReduce(cartPromotionItemList,itemList,promotionProduct);
104 |                 }
105 |             } else {
106 |                 //无优惠
107 |                 handleNoReduce(cartPromotionItemList, itemList,promotionProduct);
108 |             }
109 |         }
110 |         return cartPromotionItemList;
111 |     }

113 |     /**

131 |             if (productCartItemList == null) {

176 |     private PmsProductFullReduction getProductFullReduction(BigDecimal totalAmount,List<PmsProductFullReduction> fullReductionList) {
177 |         //按条件从高到低排序
178 |         fullReductionList.sort(new Comparator<PmsProductFullReduction>() {
179 |             @Override
180 |             public int compare(PmsProductFullReduction o1, PmsProductFullReduction o2) {
181 |                 return o2.getFullPrice().subtract(o1.getFullPrice()).intValue();
182 |             }
183 |         });
184 |         for(PmsProductFullReduction fullReduction:fullReductionList){
185 |             if(totalAmount.subtract(fullReduction.getFullPrice()).intValue()>=0){
186 |                 return fullReduction;
187 |             }
188 |         }
189 |         return null;
190 |     }

200 |         sb.append("件，");

211 |         //按数量从大到小排序
212 |         productLadderList.sort(new Comparator<PmsProductLadder>() {
213 |             @Override
```

```java
 94 |         List<PmsProductAttribute> productAttributeList = productAttributeMapper.selectByExample(attributeExample);

 99 |             PmsProductAttributeValueExample attributeValueExample = new PmsProductAttributeValueExample();
100 |             attributeValueExample.createCriteria().andProductIdEqualTo(product.getId())
101 |                     .andProductAttributeIdIn(attributeIds);
102 |             List<PmsProductAttributeValue> productAttributeValueList = productAttributeValueMapper.selectByExample(attributeValueExample);
103 |             result.setProductAttributeValueList(productAttributeValueList);

122 |             result.setProductFullReductionList(productFullReductionList);
123 |         }

130 |     /**
131 |      * 初始对象转化为节点对象
132 |      */
133 |     private PmsProductCategoryNode covert(PmsProductCategory item, List<PmsProductCategory> allList) {
134 |         PmsProductCategoryNode node = new PmsProductCategoryNode();
135 |         BeanUtils.copyProperties(item, node);
136 |         List<PmsProductCategoryNode> children = allList.stream()
137 |                 .filter(subItem -> subItem.getParentId().equals(item.getId()))
138 |                 .map(subItem -> covert(subItem, allList)).collect(Collectors.toList());
139 |         node.setChildren(children);
140 |         return node;
141 |     }
```

```java
189 |         order.setCreateTime(new Date());
190 |         order.setMemberUsername(currentMember.getUsername());
191 |         //支付方式：0->未支付；1->支付宝；2->微信
192 |         order.setPayType(orderParam.getPayType());
193 |         //订单来源：0->PC订单；1->app订单
194 |         order.setSourceType(1);
195 |         //订单状态：0->待付款；1->待发货；2->已发货；3->已完成；4->已关闭；5->无效订单
196 |         order.setStatus(0);
197 |         //订单类型：0->正常订单；1->秒杀订单
198 |         order.setOrderType(0);
199 |         //收货人信息：姓名、电话、邮编、地址
200 |         UmsMemberReceiveAddress address = memberReceiveAddressService.getItem(orderParam.getMemberReceiveAddressId());
201 |         order.setReceiverName(address.getName());
202 |         order.setReceiverPhone(address.getPhoneNumber());
203 |         order.setReceiverPostCode(address.getPostCode());
204 |         order.setReceiverProvince(address.getProvince());
205 |         order.setReceiverCity(address.getCity());
206 |         order.setReceiverRegion(address.getRegion());
207 |         order.setReceiverDetailAddress(address.getDetailAddress());
208 |         //0->未确认；1->已确认
209 |         order.setConfirmStatus(0);
210 |         order.setDeleteStatus(0);
211 |         //计算赠送积分
212 |         order.setIntegration(calcGifIntegration(orderItemList));
213 |         //计算赠送成长值
214 |         order.setGrowth(calcGiftGrowth(orderItemList));
215 |         //生成订单号
216 |         order.setOrderSn(generateOrderSn(order));
217 |         //设置自动收货天数
218 |         List<OmsOrderSetting> orderSettings = orderSettingMapper.selectByExample(new OmsOrderSettingExample());
219 |         if(CollUtil.isNotEmpty(orderSettings)){
220 |             order.setAutoConfirmDay(orderSettings.get(0).getConfirmOvertime());
221 |         }
222 |         // TODO: 2018/9/3 bill_*,delivery_*
223 |         //插入order表和order_item表
224 |         orderMapper.insert(order);
225 |         for (OmsOrderItem orderItem : orderItemList) {
226 |             orderItem.setOrderId(order.getId());
227 |             orderItem.setOrderSn(order.getOrderSn());
228 |         }
229 |         orderItemDao.insertList(orderItemList);
230 |         //如使用优惠券更新优惠券使用状态
231 |         if (orderParam.getCouponId() != null) {
232 |             updateCouponStatus(orderParam.getCouponId(), currentMember.getId(), 1);
233 |         }
234 |         //如使用积分需要扣除积分
235 |         if (orderParam.getUseIntegration() != null) {
236 |             order.setUseIntegration(orderParam.getUseIntegration());
237 |             if(currentMember.getIntegration()==null){
238 |                 currentMember.setIntegration(0);
239 |             }
240 |             memberService.updateIntegration(currentMember.getId(), currentMember.getIntegration() - orderParam.getUseIntegration());
241 |         }
242 |         //删除购物车中的下单商品
243 |         deleteCartItemList(cartPromotionItemList, currentMember);
244 |         //发送延迟消息取消订单
245 |         sendDelayMessageCancelOrder(order.getId());
246 |         Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
247 |         result.put("order", order);
248 |         result.put("orderItemList", orderItemList);
249 |         return result;
250 |     }

267 |     @Override
268 |     public Integer cancelTimeOutOrder() {
269 |         Integer count=0;
270 |         OmsOrderSetting orderSetting = orderSettingMapper.selectByPrimaryKey(1L);
271 |         //查询超时、未支付的订单及订单详情
272 |         List<OmsOrderDetail> timeOutOrders = portalOrderDao.getTimeOutOrders(orderSetting.getNormalOrderOvertime());
273 |         if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(timeOutOrders)) {
274 |             return count;
275 |         }
276 |         //修改订单状态为交易取消
277 |         List<Long> ids = new ArrayList<>();
278 |         for (OmsOrderDetail timeOutOrder : timeOutOrders) {
279 |             ids.add(timeOutOrder.getId());
280 |         }
281 |         portalOrderDao.updateOrderStatus(ids, 4);
282 |         for (OmsOrderDetail timeOutOrder : timeOutOrders) {
283 |             //解除订单商品库存锁定
284 |             portalOrderDao.releaseSkuStockLock(timeOutOrder.getOrderItemList());
285 |             //修改优惠券使用状态
286 |             updateCouponStatus(timeOutOrder.getCouponId(), timeOutOrder.getMemberId(), 0);
287 |             //返还使用积分
288 |             if (timeOutOrder.getUseIntegration() != null) {
289 |                 UmsMember member = memberService.getById(timeOutOrder.getMemberId());
290 |                 memberService.updateIntegration(timeOutOrder.getMemberId(), member.getIntegration() + timeOutOrder.getUseIntegration());
291 |             }
292 |         }
293 |         return timeOutOrders.size();
294 |     }

296 |     @Override
297 |     public void cancelOrder(Long orderId) {
298 |         //查询未付款的取消订单
299 |         OmsOrderExample example = new OmsOrderExample();
300 |         example.createCriteria().andIdEqualTo(orderId).andStatusEqualTo(0).andDeleteStatusEqualTo(0);
301 |         List<OmsOrder> cancelOrderList = orderMapper.selectByExample(example);
302 |         if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(cancelOrderList)) {
303 |             return;
304 |         }
305 |         OmsOrder cancelOrder = cancelOrderList.get(0);
306 |         if (cancelOrder != null) {
307 |             //修改订单状态为取消
308 |             cancelOrder.setStatus(4);
309 |             orderMapper.updateByPrimaryKeySelective(cancelOrder);
310 |             OmsOrderItemExample orderItemExample = new OmsOrderItemExample();
311 |             orderItemExample.createCriteria().andOrderIdEqualTo(orderId);
312 |             List<OmsOrderItem> orderItemList = orderItemMapper.selectByExample(orderItemExample);
313 |             //解除订单商品库存锁定
314 |             if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(orderItemList)) {
315 |                 portalOrderDao.releaseSkuStockLock(orderItemList);

317 |             //修改优惠券使用状态
318 |             updateCouponStatus(cancelOrder.getCouponId(), cancelOrder.getMemberId(), 0);
319 |             //返还使用积分
320 |             if (cancelOrder.getUseIntegration() != null) {
321 |                 UmsMember member = memberService.getById(cancelOrder.getMemberId());
322 |                 memberService.updateIntegration(cancelOrder.getMemberId(), member.getIntegration() + cancelOrder.getUseIntegration());
323 |             }
324 |         }
325 |     }

436 |     /**
437 |      * 生成18位订单编号:8位日期+2位平台号码+2位支付方式+6位以上自增id
438 |      */
439 |     private String generateOrderSn(OmsOrder order) {
440 |         StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
441 |         String date = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd").format(new Date());
442 |         String key = REDIS_DATABASE+":"+ REDIS_KEY_ORDER_ID + date;
443 |         Long increment = redisService.incr(key, 1);
444 |         sb.append(date);
445 |         sb.append(String.format("%02d", order.getSourceType()));
446 |         sb.append(String.format("%02d", order.getPayType()));
447 |         String incrementStr = increment.toString();
448 |         if (incrementStr.length() <= 6) {
449 |             sb.append(String.format("%06d", increment));
450 |         } else {
451 |             sb.append(incrementStr);
452 |         }
453 |         return sb.toString();
454 |     }

541 |     private BigDecimal calcPayAmount(OmsOrder order) {
542 |         //总金额+运费-促销优惠-优惠券优惠-积分抵扣
543 |         BigDecimal payAmount = order.getTotalAmount()
544 |                 .add(order.getFreightAmount())
```
