```java
590 |     /**
591 |      * 获取可用积分抵扣金额
592 |      *
593 |      * @param useIntegration 使用的积分数量
594 |      * @param totalAmount    订单总金额
595 |      * @param currentMember  使用的用户
596 |      * @param hasCoupon      是否已经使用优惠券
597 |      */
598 |     private BigDecimal getUseIntegrationAmount(Integer useIntegration, BigDecimal totalAmount, UmsMember currentMember, boolean hasCoupon) {
599 |         BigDecimal zeroAmount = new BigDecimal(0);
600 |         //判断用户是否有这么多积分
601 |         if (useIntegration.compareTo(currentMember.getIntegration()) > 0) {
602 |             return zeroAmount;
603 |         }
604 |         //根据积分使用规则判断是否可用
605 |         //是否可与优惠券共用
606 |         UmsIntegrationConsumeSetting integrationConsumeSetting = integrationConsumeSettingMapper.selectByPrimaryKey(1L);
607 |         if (hasCoupon && integrationConsumeSetting.getCouponStatus().equals(0)) {
608 |             //不可与优惠券共用
609 |             return zeroAmount;
610 |         }
611 |         //是否达到最低使用积分门槛
612 |         if (useIntegration.compareTo(integrationConsumeSetting.getUseUnit()) < 0) {
613 |             return zeroAmount;
614 |         }
615 |         //是否超过订单抵用最高百分比
616 |         BigDecimal integrationAmount = new BigDecimal(useIntegration).divide(new BigDecimal(integrationConsumeSetting.getUseUnit()), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
617 |         BigDecimal maxPercent = new BigDecimal(integrationConsumeSetting.getMaxPercentPerOrder()).divide(new BigDecimal(100), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
618 |         if (integrationAmount.compareTo(totalAmount.multiply(maxPercent)) > 0) {
619 |             return zeroAmount;
620 |         }
621 |         return integrationAmount;
622 |     }
623 | 
624 |     /**
625 |      * 对优惠券优惠进行处理
626 |      *
627 |      * @param orderItemList       order_item列表
628 |      * @param couponHistoryDetail 可用优惠券详情
629 |      */
630 |     private void handleCouponAmount(List<OmsOrderItem> orderItemList, SmsCouponHistoryDetail couponHistoryDetail) {
631 |         SmsCoupon coupon = couponHistoryDetail.getCoupon();
632 |         if (coupon.getUseType().equals(0)) {
633 |             //全场通用
634 |             calcPerCouponAmount(orderItemList, coupon);
635 |         } else if (coupon.getUseType().equals(1)) {
636 |             //指定分类
637 |             List<OmsOrderItem> couponOrderItemList = getCouponOrderItemByRelation(couponHistoryDetail, orderItemList, 0);
638 |             calcPerCouponAmount(couponOrderItemList, coupon);
639 |         } else if (coupon.getUseType().equals(2)) {
640 |             //指定商品
641 |             List<OmsOrderItem> couponOrderItemList = getCouponOrderItemByRelation(couponHistoryDetail, orderItemList, 1);
642 |             calcPerCouponAmount(couponOrderItemList, coupon);
643 |         }
644 |     }
645 | 
646 |     /**
647 |      * 对每个下单商品进行优惠券金额分摊的计算
648 |      *
649 |      * @param orderItemList 可用优惠券的下单商品商品
650 |      */
651 |     private void calcPerCouponAmount(List<OmsOrderItem> orderItemList, SmsCoupon coupon) {
652 |         BigDecimal totalAmount = calcTotalAmount(orderItemList);
653 |         for (OmsOrderItem orderItem : orderItemList) {
654 |             //(商品价格/可用商品总价)*优惠券面额
655 |             BigDecimal couponAmount = orderItem.getProductPrice().divide(totalAmount, 3, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN).multiply(coupon.getAmount());
656 |             orderItem.setCouponAmount(couponAmount);
657 |         }
658 |     }

660 |     /**
661 |      * 获取与优惠券有关系的下单商品
662 |      *
663 |      * @param couponHistoryDetail 优惠券详情
664 |      * @param orderItemList       下单商品
665 |      * @param type                使用关系类型：0->相关分类；1->指定商品
666 |      */
667 |     private List<OmsOrderItem> getCouponOrderItemByRelation(SmsCouponHistoryDetail couponHistoryDetail, List<OmsOrderItem> orderItemList, int type) {
668 |         List<OmsOrderItem> result = new ArrayList<>();
669 |         if (type == 0) {
670 |             List<Long> categoryIdList = new ArrayList<>();
671 |             for (SmsCouponProductCategoryRelation productCategoryRelation : couponHistoryDetail.getCategoryRelationList()) {
672 |                 categoryIdList.add(productCategoryRelation.getProductCategoryId());
673 |             }
674 |             for (OmsOrderItem orderItem : orderItemList) {
675 |                 if (categoryIdList.contains(orderItem.getProductCategoryId())) {
676 |                     result.add(orderItem);
677 |                 } else {
678 |                     orderItem.setCouponAmount(new BigDecimal(0));
679 |                 }
680 |             }
681 |         } else if (type == 1) {
682 |             List<Long> productIdList = new ArrayList<>();
683 |             for (SmsCouponProductRelation productRelation : couponHistoryDetail.getProductRelationList()) {
684 |                 productIdList.add(productRelation.getProductId());
685 |             }
686 |             for (OmsOrderItem orderItem : orderItemList) {
687 |                 if (productIdList.contains(orderItem.getProductId())) {
688 |                     result.add(orderItem);
689 |                 } else {
690 |                     orderItem.setCouponAmount(new BigDecimal(0));
691 |                 }
692 |             }
693 |         }
694 |         return result;
695 |     }

697 |     /**
698 |      * 获取该用户可以使用的优惠券
699 |      *
700 |      * @param cartPromotionItemList 购物车优惠列表
701 |      * @param couponId              使用优惠券id
702 |      */
703 |     private SmsCouponHistoryDetail getUseCoupon(List<CartPromotionItem> cartPromotionItemList, Long couponId) {
704 |         List<SmsCouponHistoryDetail> couponHistoryDetailList = memberCouponService.listCart(cartPromotionItemList, 1);
705 |         for (SmsCouponHistoryDetail couponHistoryDetail : couponHistoryDetailList) {
706 |             if (couponHistoryDetail.getCoupon().getId().equals(couponId)) {
707 |                 return couponHistoryDetail;
708 |             }
709 |         }
710 |         return null;
711 |     }
712 | 
713 |     /**
714 |      * 计算总金额
715 |      */
716 |     private BigDecimal calcTotalAmount(List<OmsOrderItem> orderItemList) {
717 |         BigDecimal totalAmount = new BigDecimal("0");
718 |         for (OmsOrderItem item : orderItemList) {
719 |             totalAmount = totalAmount.add(item.getProductPrice().multiply(new BigDecimal(item.getProductQuantity())));
720 |         }
721 |         return totalAmount;
722 |     }
723 | 
724 |     /**
725 |      * 锁定下单商品的所有库存
726 |      */
727 |     private void lockStock(List<CartPromotionItem> cartPromotionItemList) {
728 |         for (CartPromotionItem cartPromotionItem : cartPromotionItemList) {
729 |             PmsSkuStock skuStock = skuStockMapper.selectByPrimaryKey(cartPromotionItem.getProductSkuId());
730 |             skuStock.setLockStock(skuStock.getLockStock() + cartPromotionItem.getQuantity());
731 |             skuStockMapper.updateByPrimaryKeySelective(skuStock);
732 |         }
733 |     }
734 | 
735 |     /**
736 |      * 判断下单商品是否都有库存
737 |      */
738 |     private boolean hasStock(List<CartPromotionItem> cartPromotionItemList) {
739 |         for (CartPromotionItem cartPromotionItem : cartPromotionItemList) {
740 |             if (cartPromotionItem.getRealStock()==null //判断真实库存是否为空
741 |                     ||cartPromotionItem.getRealStock() <= 0 //判断真实库存是否小于0
742 |                     || cartPromotionItem.getRealStock() < cartPromotionItem.getQuantity()) //判断真实库存是否小于下单的数量
743 |             {
744 |                 return false;
745 |             }
746 |         }
747 |         return true;
748 |     }
749 | 
750 |     /**
751 |      * 计算购物车中商品的价格
752 |      */
753 |     private ConfirmOrderResult.CalcAmount calcCartAmount(List<CartPromotionItem> cartPromotionItemList) {
754 |         ConfirmOrderResult.CalcAmount calcAmount = new ConfirmOrderResult.CalcAmount();
755 |         calcAmount.setFreightAmount(new BigDecimal(0));
756 |         BigDecimal totalAmount = new BigDecimal("0");
757 |         BigDecimal promotionAmount = new BigDecimal("0");
758 |         for (CartPromotionItem cartPromotionItem : cartPromotionItemList) {
759 |             totalAmount = totalAmount.add(cartPromotionItem.getPrice().multiply(new BigDecimal(cartPromotionItem.getQuantity())));
760 |             promotionAmount = promotionAmount.add(cartPromotionItem.getReduceAmount().multiply(new BigDecimal(cartPromotionItem.getQuantity())));
761 |         }
762 |         calcAmount.setTotalAmount(totalAmount);
763 |         calcAmount.setPromotionAmount(promotionAmount);
764 |         calcAmount.setPayAmount(totalAmount.subtract(promotionAmount));
765 |         return calcAmount;
766 |     }
767 | 
768 | }
```

```java
45 |         }else if(AuthConstant.PORTAL_CLIENT_ID.equals(clientId)){

47 |         }else{
48 |             return CommonResult.failed("clientId不正确");
49 |         }
50 |     }
```

```java
25 | /**
26 |  * @auther macrozheng
27 |  * @description Spring Boot Admin的Security相关配置
28 |  * @date 2024/1/16
29 |  * @github https://github.com/macrozheng
30 |  */
31 | @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
32 | public class SecuritySecureConfig {
33 | 
34 |     private final AdminServerProperties adminServer;
35 | 
36 |     private final SecurityProperties security;
37 | 
38 |     public SecuritySecureConfig(AdminServerProperties adminServer, SecurityProperties security) {
39 |         this.adminServer = adminServer;
40 |         this.security = security;
41 |     }
42 | 
43 |     @Bean
44 |     protected SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
45 |         SavedRequestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandler successHandler = new SavedRequestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandler();
46 |         successHandler.setTargetUrlParameter("redirectTo");
47 |         successHandler.setDefaultTargetUrl(this.adminServer.path("/"));
48 |         http.authorizeHttpRequests((authorizeRequests) -> authorizeRequests //
49 |                 .requestMatchers(new AntPathRequestMatcher(this.adminServer.path("/assets/**")))
50 |                 .permitAll()
51 |                 .requestMatchers(new AntPathRequestMatcher(this.adminServer.path("/actuator/info")))
52 |                 .permitAll()
53 |                 .requestMatchers(new AntPathRequestMatcher(adminServer.path("/actuator/health")))
54 |                 .permitAll()
55 |                 .requestMatchers(new AntPathRequestMatcher(this.adminServer.path("/login")))
56 |                 .permitAll()
57 |                 .dispatcherTypeMatchers(DispatcherType.ASYNC)
58 |                 .permitAll()
59 |                 .anyRequest()
60 |                 .authenticated())
61 |                 .formLogin(
62 |                         (formLogin) -> formLogin.loginPage(this.adminServer.path("/login")).successHandler(successHandler))
63 |                 .logout((logout) -> logout.logoutUrl(this.adminServer.path("/logout")))
64 |                 .httpBasic(Customizer.withDefaults());
65 |         http.addFilterAfter(new CustomCsrfFilter(), BasicAuthenticationFilter.class)
66 |                 .csrf((csrf) -> csrf.csrfTokenRepository(CookieCsrfTokenRepository.withHttpOnlyFalse())
67 |                         .csrfTokenRequestHandler(new CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler())
68 |                         .ignoringRequestMatchers(
69 |                                 new AntPathRequestMatcher(this.adminServer.path("/instances"), "POST"),
70 |         new AntPathRequestMatcher(this.adminServer.path("/instances/*"), "DELETE"),
71 |         new AntPathRequestMatcher(this.adminServer.path("/actuator/**"))
72 |                                 ));
73 |         http.rememberMe((rememberMe) -> rememberMe.key(UUID.randomUUID().toString()).tokenValiditySeconds(1209600));
74 |         return http.build();
75 |     }
76 | 
77 |     @Bean
78 |     public InMemoryUserDetailsManager userDetailsService(PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder) {
79 |         UserDetails user = User.withUsername("macro")
80 |                 .password(passwordEncoder.encode("123456"))
81 |                 .roles("USER")
82 |                 .build();
83 |         return new InMemoryUserDetailsManager(user);
84 |     }
85 | 
86 |     @Bean
87 |     public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {
88 |         return new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
89 |     }
90 | 
91 | }
```

```java
39 |     public static final String CSRF_COOKIE_NAME = "XSRF-TOKEN";
40 | 
41 |     @Override
42 |     protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, FilterChain filterChain)
43 |             throws ServletException, IOException {
44 |         CsrfToken csrf = (CsrfToken) request.getAttribute(CsrfToken.class.getName());
45 |         if (csrf != null) {
46 |             Cookie cookie = WebUtils.getCookie(request, CSRF_COOKIE_NAME);
47 |             String token = csrf.getToken();
48 |             if (cookie == null || token != null && !token.equals(cookie.getValue())) {
49 |                 cookie = new Cookie(CSRF_COOKIE_NAME, token);
50 |                 cookie.setPath("/");
51 |                 response.addCookie(cookie);
52 |             }
53 |         }
54 |         filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
55 |     }
56 | 
57 | }
```

## File: /Users/panda/IdeaProjects/mall-swarm/document/sh/mall-gateway.sh

- Extension: .sh
- Language: bash
- Size: 507 bytes
- Created: 2025-08-14 16:52:16
- Modified: 2025-08-14 16:52:16

### Code

```bash
 1 | #!/usr/bin/env bash
 2 | app_name='mall-gateway'
 3 | docker stop ${app_name}
 4 | echo '----stop container----'
 5 | docker rm ${app_name}
 6 | echo '----rm container----'
 7 | docker rmi `docker images | grep none | awk '{print $3}'`
 8 | echo '----rm none images----'
 9 | docker run -p 8201:8201 --name ${app_name} \
10 | --link redis:redis \
11 | --link nacos-registry:nacos-registry \
12 | -e TZ="Asia/Shanghai" \
13 | -v /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime \
14 | -v /mydata/app/${app_name}/logs:/var/logs \
15 | -d mall/${app_name}:1.0-SNAPSHOT
16 | echo '----start container----'
```

## File: /Users/panda/IdeaProjects/mall-swarm/document/reference/deploy_windows.md

- Extension: .md
- Language: markdown
- Size: 3354 bytes
- Created: 2025-08-14 16:52:16
- Modified: 2025-08-14 16:52:16

### Code

```markdown
 1 | # mall-swarm 在Windows环境下的部署
 2 | 
 3 | ## 开发环境搭建
 4 | 
 5 | > `mall-swarm`中使用到的环境和`mall`项目中大致相同，具体可以查看[mall在Windows环境下的部署](https://github.com/macrozheng/mall-learning/blob/master/docs/deploy/mall_deploy_windows.md)。
 6 | 
 7 | 简易环境搭建流程：
 8 | 
 9 | - 安装IDEA并导入项目源码；
10 | - 安装MySql，创建一个`mall`数据库，并导入`/document/sql/mall.sql`文件；
11 | - 安装Redis、Elasticsearch、MongoDB、RabbitMQ等环境。
12 | 
13 | ## 项目部署
14 | 
15 | > `mall-swarm`项目启动有先后顺序，大家要按照以下顺序启动。
16 | 
17 | ### 启动注册中心`mall-registory`
18 | 
19 | - 直接运行com.macro.mall.MallRegistryApplication的main函数即可；
20 | - 运行完成后可以通过注册中心控制台查看：http://localhost:8001
21 | 
22 | ### 启动配置中心`mall-config`
23 | 
24 | - 直接运行com.macro.mall.MallConfigApplication的main函数即可；
25 | - 访问以下接口获取mall-admin在dev环境下的配置信息：http://localhost:8301/master/admin-dev.yml
26 | 
27 | ### 启动监控中心`mall-monitor`
28 | 
29 | - 直接运行com.macro.mall.MallMonitorApplication的main函数即可；
30 | - 运行完成后可以通过监控中心控制台查看：http://localhost:8101
31 | - 输入账号密码`macro:123456`可以登录查看。
32 | 
33 | ### 启动网关服务`mall-gateway`
34 | 
35 | - 直接运行com.macro.mall.MallGatewayApplication的main函数即可；
36 | - 访问以下接口获取动态路由规则：http://localhost:8201/actuator/gateway/routes
37 | 
38 | ### 启动后台管理服务`mall-admin`
39 | 
40 | - 直接运行com.macro.mall.MallAdminApplication的main函数即可；
41 | - 通过`mall-gateway`网关服务访问接口文档：http://localhost:8201/mall-admin/swagger-ui.html
42 | 
43 | ![](../resource/mall_swarm_windows_06.png)
44 | 
45 | - 登录接口地址：http://localhost:8201/mall-admin/admin/login
46 | - 访问登录接口获取到token后放入认证的头信息即可正常访问其他需要登录的接口：
47 | 
48 | ![](../resource/mall_swarm_windows_09.png)
49 | 
50 | ### 启动前台服务`mall-portal`
51 | 
52 | - 直接运行com.macro.mall.portal.MallPortalApplication的main函数即可；
53 | - 通过`mall-gateway`网关服务访问接口文档：http://localhost:8201/mall-portal/swagger-ui.html
54 | 
55 | ![](../resource/mall_swarm_windows_07.png)
56 | 
57 | - 登录接口地址：http://localhost:8201/mall-portal/sso/login
58 | - 调用需要登录的接口方式同`mall-admin`。
59 | 
60 | ### 启动搜索服务`mall-search`
61 | 
62 | - 直接运行com.macro.mall.search.MallSearchApplication的main函数即可；
63 | - 通过`mall-gateway`网关服务访问接口文档：http://localhost:8201/mall-search/swagger-ui.html
64 | 
65 | ![](../resource/mall_swarm_windows_10.png)
66 | 
67 | ### 启动测试服务`mall-demo`
68 | 
69 | - 直接运行com.macro.mall.MallAdminApplication的main函数即可；
70 | - 通过`mall-gateway`网关服务访问接口文档：http://localhost:8201/mall-demo/swagger-ui.html
71 | 
72 | ![](../resource/mall_swarm_windows_08.png)
73 |
```

```markdown
373 | - 获取验证码：后台生成验证码，验证码绑定手机号
374 | - 忘记密码：手机号、短信验证码、新密码
375 | - 登出功能
```

```sql
 415 | -- ----------------------------
 416 | -- Table structure for oms_company_address
 417 | -- ----------------------------
 418 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `oms_company_address`;
 419 | CREATE TABLE `oms_company_address`  (
 420 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 421 |   `address_name` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '地址名称',
 422 |   `send_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '默认发货地址：0->否；1->是',
 423 |   `receive_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '是否默认收货地址：0->否；1->是',
 424 |   `name` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收发货人姓名',
 425 |   `phone` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收货人电话',
 426 |   `province` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '省/直辖市',
 427 |   `city` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '市',
 428 |   `region` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '区',
 429 |   `detail_address` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '详细地址',
 430 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
 431 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 4 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '公司收发货地址表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

 440 | -- ----------------------------
 441 | -- Table structure for oms_order
 442 | -- ----------------------------
 443 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `oms_order`;
 444 | CREATE TABLE `oms_order`  (
 445 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '订单id',
 446 |   `member_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
 447 |   `coupon_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 448 |   `order_sn` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单编号',
 449 |   `create_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '提交时间',
 450 |   `member_username` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '用户帐号',
 451 |   `total_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单总金额',
 452 |   `pay_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '应付金额（实际支付金额）',
 453 |   `freight_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '运费金额',
 454 |   `promotion_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '促销优化金额（促销价、满减、阶梯价）',
 455 |   `integration_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '积分抵扣金额',
 456 |   `coupon_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '优惠券抵扣金额',
 457 |   `discount_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '管理员后台调整订单使用的折扣金额',
 458 |   `pay_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支付方式：0->未支付；1->支付宝；2->微信',
 459 |   `source_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单来源：0->PC订单；1->app订单',
 460 |   `status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单状态：0->待付款；1->待发货；2->已发货；3->已完成；4->已关闭；5->无效订单',
 461 |   `order_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单类型：0->正常订单；1->秒杀订单',
 462 |   `delivery_company` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '物流公司(配送方式)',
 463 |   `delivery_sn` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '物流单号',
 464 |   `auto_confirm_day` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '自动确认时间（天）',
 465 |   `integration` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可以获得的积分',
 466 |   `growth` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可以活动的成长值',
 467 |   `promotion_info` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '活动信息',
 468 |   `bill_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '发票类型：0->不开发票；1->电子发票；2->纸质发票',
 469 |   `bill_header` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '发票抬头',
 470 |   `bill_content` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '发票内容',
 471 |   `bill_receiver_phone` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收票人电话',
 472 |   `bill_receiver_email` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收票人邮箱',
 473 |   `receiver_name` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '收货人姓名',
 474 |   `receiver_phone` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '收货人电话',
 475 |   `receiver_post_code` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收货人邮编',
 476 |   `receiver_province` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '省份/直辖市',
 477 |   `receiver_city` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '城市',
 478 |   `receiver_region` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '区',
 479 |   `receiver_detail_address` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '详细地址',
 480 |   `note` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单备注',
 481 |   `confirm_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '确认收货状态：0->未确认；1->已确认',
 482 |   `delete_status` int(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '删除状态：0->未删除；1->已删除',
 483 |   `use_integration` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '下单时使用的积分',
 484 |   `payment_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支付时间',
 485 |   `delivery_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '发货时间',
 486 |   `receive_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '确认收货时间',
 487 |   `comment_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '评价时间',
 488 |   `modify_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '修改时间',
 489 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
 490 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 77 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '订单表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

 561 | -- ----------------------------
 562 | -- Table structure for oms_order_item
 563 | -- ----------------------------
 564 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `oms_order_item`;
 565 | CREATE TABLE `oms_order_item`  (
 566 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 567 |   `order_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单id',
 568 |   `order_sn` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单编号',
 569 |   `product_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 570 |   `product_pic` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 571 |   `product_name` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 572 |   `product_brand` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 573 |   `product_sn` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 574 |   `product_price` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '销售价格',
 575 |   `product_quantity` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '购买数量',
 576 |   `product_sku_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品sku编号',
 577 |   `product_sku_code` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品sku条码',
 578 |   `product_category_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品分类id',
 579 |   `promotion_name` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品促销名称',
 580 |   `promotion_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品促销分解金额',
 581 |   `coupon_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '优惠券优惠分解金额',
 582 |   `integration_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '积分优惠分解金额',
 583 |   `real_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '该商品经过优惠后的分解金额',
 584 |   `gift_integration` int(11) NULL DEFAULT 0,
 585 |   `gift_growth` int(11) NULL DEFAULT 0,
 586 |   `product_attr` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品销售属性:[{\"key\":\"颜色\",\"value\":\"颜色\"},{\"key\":\"容量\",\"value\":\"4G\"}]',
 587 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
 588 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 115 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '订单中所包含的商品' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

 688 | -- ----------------------------
 689 | -- Table structure for oms_order_operate_history
 690 | -- ----------------------------
 691 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `oms_order_operate_history`;
 692 | CREATE TABLE `oms_order_operate_history`  (
 693 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 694 |   `order_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单id',
 695 |   `operate_man` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '操作人：用户；系统；后台管理员',
 696 |   `create_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '操作时间',
 697 |   `order_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单状态：0->待付款；1->待发货；2->已发货；3->已完成；4->已关闭；5->无效订单',
 698 |   `note` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注',
 699 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
 700 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 44 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '订单操作历史记录' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

 746 | -- Table structure for oms_order_return_apply
 747 | -- ----------------------------
 748 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `oms_order_return_apply`;
 749 | CREATE TABLE `oms_order_return_apply`  (
 750 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 751 |   `order_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单id',
 752 |   `company_address_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收货地址表id',
 753 |   `product_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '退货商品id',
 754 |   `order_sn` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单编号',
 755 |   `create_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '申请时间',
 756 |   `member_username` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '会员用户名',
 757 |   `return_amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '退款金额',
 758 |   `return_name` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '退货人姓名',
 759 |   `return_phone` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '退货人电话',
 760 |   `status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '申请状态：0->待处理；1->退货中；2->已完成；3->已拒绝',
 761 |   `handle_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '处理时间',
 762 |   `product_pic` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品图片',
 763 |   `product_name` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品名称',
 764 |   `product_brand` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品品牌',
 765 |   `product_attr` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品销售属性：颜色：红色；尺码：xl;',
 766 |   `product_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '退货数量',
 767 |   `product_price` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品单价',
 768 |   `product_real_price` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品实际支付单价',
 769 |   `reason` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原因',
 770 |   `description` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '描述',
 771 |   `proof_pics` varchar(1000) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '凭证图片，以逗号隔开',
 772 |   `handle_note` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '处理备注',
 773 |   `handle_man` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '处理人员',
 774 |   `receive_man` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收货人',
 775 |   `receive_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收货时间',
 776 |   `receive_note` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '收货备注',
 777 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
 778 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 27 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '订单退货申请' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;
 779 |

 889 |   `name` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,

 891 |   `sort` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 892 |   `factory_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '是否为品牌制造商：0->不是；1->是',
 893 |   `show_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 894 |   `product_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品数量',
 895 |   `product_comment_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品评论数量',
 896 |   `logo` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '品牌logo',
 897 |   `big_pic` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '专区大图',
 898 |   `brand_story` text CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL COMMENT '品牌故事',
 899 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
 900 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 60 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '品牌表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

 905 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (1, '万和', 'W', 0, 1, 1, 100, 100, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20200607/5b07ca8aN4e127d2f.jpg', 'http://img13.360buyimg.com/cms/jfs/t1/121860/35/2430/187800/5ec4e294E22f3ffcc/1e233b65b94ba192.jpg', '万和成立于1993年8月，总部位于广东顺德国家级高新技术开发区内，是国内生产规模最大的燃气具专业制造企业，也是中国燃气具发展战略的首倡者和推动者、中国五金制品协会燃气用具分会第三届理事长单位。');
 906 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (2, '三星', 'S', 100, 1, 1, 100, 100, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20200607/57201b47N7bf15715.jpg', 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20221108/sanxing_banner_01.png', '三星集团（英文：SAMSUNG、韩文：삼성）是韩国最大的跨国企业集团，三星集团包括众多的国际下属企业，旗下子公司有：三星电子、三星物产、三星人寿保险等，业务涉及电子、金融、机械、化学等众多领域。');
 907 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (3, '华为', 'H', 100, 1, 1, 100, 100, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20200607/5abf6f26N31658aa2.jpg', 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20221108/huawei_banner_01.png', '荣耀品牌成立于2013年,是华为旗下手机双品牌之一。荣耀以“创新、品质、服务”为核心战略,为全球年轻人提供潮酷的全场景智能化体验,打造年轻人向往的先锋文化和潮流生活方式');
 908 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (4, '格力', 'G', 30, 1, 1, 100, 100, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20180607/timg (3).jpg', NULL, 'Victoria\'s Secret的故事');
 909 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (5, '方太', 'F', 20, 1, 1, 100, 100, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20180607/timg (4).jpg', NULL, 'Victoria\'s Secret的故事');
 910 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (6, '小米', 'M', 500, 1, 1, 100, 100, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20200607/5565f5a2N0b8169ae.jpg', 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20221108/xiaomi_banner_01.png', '小米公司正式成立于2010年4月，是一家专注于高端智能手机、互联网电视自主研发的创新型科技企业。主要由前谷歌、微软、摩托、金山等知名公司的顶尖人才组建。');
 911 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (21, 'OPPO', 'O', 0, 1, 1, 88, 500, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20180607/timg(6).jpg', 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20221108/oppo_banner_01.png', 'OPPO于2008年推出第一款“笑脸手机”，由此开启探索和引领至美科技之旅。今天，OPPO凭借以Find和R系列手机为核心的智能终端产品，以及OPPO+等互联网服务，让全球消费者尽享至美科技。');
 912 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (49, '七匹狼', 'S', 200, 1, 1, 77, 400, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20190525/qipilang.png', NULL, 'BOOB的故事');
 913 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (50, '海澜之家', 'H', 200, 1, 1, 66, 300, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20200607/5a5c69b9N5d6c5696.jpg', 'http://img10.360buyimg.com/cms/jfs/t1/133148/4/1605/470028/5edaf5ccEd7a687a9/e0a007631361ff75.jpg', '“海澜之家”（英文缩写：HLA）是海澜之家股份有限公司旗下的服装品牌，总部位于中国江苏省无锡市江阴市，主要采用连锁零售的模式，销售男性服装、配饰与相关产品。');
 914 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (51, '苹果', 'A', 200, 1, 1, 55, 200, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20200607/49b30bb0377030d1.jpg', 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20221108/apple_banner_01.png', '苹果公司(Apple Inc. )是美国的一家高科技公司。 由史蒂夫·乔布斯、斯蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克和罗·韦恩(Ron Wayne)等人于1976年4月1日创立,并命名为美国苹果电脑公司(Apple Computer Inc. ),2007年1月9日更名为苹果公司,总部位于加利福尼亚州的...');
 915 | INSERT INTO `pms_brand` VALUES (58, 'NIKE', 'N', 0, 1, 0, 33, 100, 'http://macro-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/mall/images/20180615/timg (51).jpg', '', 'NIKE的故事');

 921 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `pms_comment`;
 922 | CREATE TABLE `pms_comment`  (
 923 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 924 |   `product_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 925 |   `member_nick_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 926 |   `product_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 927 |   `star` int(3) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '评价星数：0->5',
 928 |   `member_ip` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '评价的ip',
 929 |   `create_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 930 |   `show_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 931 |   `product_attribute` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '购买时的商品属性',
 932 |   `collect_couont` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 933 |   `read_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 934 |   `content` text CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL,
 935 |   `pics` varchar(1000) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '上传图片地址，以逗号隔开',
 936 |   `member_icon` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '评论用户头像',
 937 |   `replay_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
 938 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
 939 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 1 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '商品评价表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

1082 | -- Table structure for pms_product
1083 | -- ----------------------------
1084 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `pms_product`;
1085 | CREATE TABLE `pms_product`  (
1086 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
1087 |   `brand_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1088 |   `product_category_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1089 |   `feight_template_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1090 |   `product_attribute_category_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1091 |   `name` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL,
1092 |   `pic` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1093 |   `product_sn` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '货号',
1094 |   `delete_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '删除状态：0->未删除；1->已删除',
1095 |   `publish_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '上架状态：0->下架；1->上架',
1096 |   `new_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '新品状态:0->不是新品；1->新品',
1097 |   `recommand_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '推荐状态；0->不推荐；1->推荐',
1098 |   `verify_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '审核状态：0->未审核；1->审核通过',
1099 |   `sort` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '排序',
1100 |   `sale` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '销量',
1101 |   `price` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1102 |   `promotion_price` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '促销价格',
1103 |   `gift_growth` int(11) NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '赠送的成长值',
1104 |   `gift_point` int(11) NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '赠送的积分',
1105 |   `use_point_limit` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '限制使用的积分数',
1106 |   `sub_title` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '副标题',
1107 |   `description` text CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL COMMENT '商品描述',
1108 |   `original_price` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '市场价',
1109 |   `stock` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '库存',
1110 |   `low_stock` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '库存预警值',
1111 |   `unit` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '单位',
1112 |   `weight` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品重量，默认为克',
1113 |   `preview_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '是否为预告商品：0->不是；1->是',
1114 |   `service_ids` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '以逗号分割的产品服务：1->无忧退货；2->快速退款；3->免费包邮',
1115 |   `keywords` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1116 |   `note` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1117 |   `album_pics` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '画册图片，连产品图片限制为5张，以逗号分割',

1121 |   `detail_mobile_html` text CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL COMMENT '移动端网页详情',

1123 |   `promotion_end_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '促销结束时间',

1125 |   `promotion_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '促销类型：0->没有促销使用原价;1->使用促销价；2->使用会员价；3->使用阶梯价格；4->使用满减价格；5->限时购',

1127 |   `product_category_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '商品分类名称',
1128 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
1129 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 46 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '商品信息' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

1172 | 
1173 | -- ----------------------------
1174 | -- Table structure for pms_product_attribute
1175 | -- ----------------------------
1176 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `pms_product_attribute`;
1177 | CREATE TABLE `pms_product_attribute`  (
1178 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
1179 |   `product_attribute_category_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1180 |   `name` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1181 |   `select_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '属性选择类型：0->唯一；1->单选；2->多选',
1182 |   `input_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '属性录入方式：0->手工录入；1->从列表中选取',
1183 |   `input_list` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可选值列表，以逗号隔开',
1184 |   `sort` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '排序字段：最高的可以单独上传图片',
1185 |   `filter_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '分类筛选样式：1->普通；1->颜色',
1186 |   `search_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '检索类型；0->不需要进行检索；1->关键字检索；2->范围检索',
1187 |   `related_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '相同属性产品是否关联；0->不关联；1->关联',
1188 |   `hand_add_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '是否支持手动新增；0->不支持；1->支持',
1189 |   `type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '属性的类型；0->规格；1->参数',
1190 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
1191 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 74 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '商品属性参数表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

1425 | -- Table structure for pms_product_category
1426 | -- ----------------------------
1427 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `pms_product_category`;
1428 | CREATE TABLE `pms_product_category`  (
1429 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
1430 |   `parent_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '上机分类的编号：0表示一级分类',
1431 |   `name` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1432 |   `level` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '分类级别：0->1级；1->2级',
1433 |   `product_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1434 |   `product_unit` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1435 |   `nav_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '是否显示在导航栏：0->不显示；1->显示',
1436 |   `show_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '显示状态：0->不显示；1->显示',
1437 |   `sort` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1438 |   `icon` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '图标',
1439 |   `keywords` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1440 |   `description` text CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL COMMENT '描述',
1441 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
1442 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 56 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '产品分类' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

1628 |   `create_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1629 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
1630 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 1 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

1664 |   `price` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1665 |   `stock` int(11) NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '库存',
1666 |   `low_stock` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '预警库存',

1672 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
1673 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 243 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = 'sku的库存' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

1775 | -- ----------------------------
1776 | -- Table structure for sms_coupon
1777 | -- ----------------------------
1778 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `sms_coupon`;
1779 | CREATE TABLE `sms_coupon`  (
1780 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
1781 |   `type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '优惠券类型；0->全场赠券；1->会员赠券；2->购物赠券；3->注册赠券',
1782 |   `name` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1783 |   `platform` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '使用平台：0->全部；1->移动；2->PC',
1784 |   `count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '数量',
1785 |   `amount` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '金额',
1786 |   `per_limit` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '每人限领张数',
1787 |   `min_point` decimal(10, 2) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '使用门槛；0表示无门槛',
1788 |   `start_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1789 |   `end_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1790 |   `use_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '使用类型：0->全场通用；1->指定分类；2->指定商品',
1791 |   `note` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注',
1792 |   `publish_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '发行数量',
1793 |   `use_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '已使用数量',
1794 |   `receive_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '领取数量',
1795 |   `enable_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可以领取的日期',
1796 |   `code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '优惠码',
1797 |   `member_level` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可领取的会员类型：0->无限时',
1798 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
1799 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 32 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '优惠券表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

1812 | -- ----------------------------
1813 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `sms_coupon_history`;
1814 | CREATE TABLE `sms_coupon_history`  (
1815 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
1816 |   `coupon_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1817 |   `member_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1818 |   `coupon_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1819 |   `member_nickname` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '领取人昵称',
1820 |   `get_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '获取类型：0->后台赠送；1->主动获取',
1821 |   `create_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL,
1822 |   `use_status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '使用状态：0->未使用；1->已使用；2->已过期',
1823 |   `use_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '使用时间',
1824 |   `order_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单编号',
1825 |   `order_sn` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单号码',
1826 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE,
1827 |   INDEX `idx_member_id`(`member_id`) USING BTREE,
1828 |   INDEX `idx_coupon_id`(`coupon_id`) USING BTREE
1829 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 53 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '优惠券使用、领取历史表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

2652 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `ums_growth_change_history`;
2653 | CREATE TABLE `ums_growth_change_history`  (
2654 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
2655 |   `member_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
2656 |   `create_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL,
2657 |   `change_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '改变类型：0->增加；1->减少',
2658 |   `change_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '积分改变数量',
2659 |   `operate_man` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '操作人员',
2660 |   `operate_note` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '操作备注',
2661 |   `source_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '积分来源：0->购物；1->管理员修改',
2662 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE
2663 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 2 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '成长值变化历史记录表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;

2696 |   `deduction_per_amount` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '每一元需要抵扣的积分数量',
2697 |   `max_percent_per_order` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '每笔订单最高抵用百分比',

2709 | -- Table structure for ums_member
2710 | -- ----------------------------
2711 | DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `ums_member`;
2712 | CREATE TABLE `ums_member`  (
2713 |   `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
2714 |   `member_level_id` bigint(20) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
2715 |   `username` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '用户名',
2716 |   `password` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '密码',
2717 |   `nickname` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '昵称',
2718 |   `phone` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '手机号码',
2719 |   `status` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '帐号启用状态:0->禁用；1->启用',
2720 |   `create_time` datetime NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '注册时间',
2721 |   `icon` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '头像',
2722 |   `gender` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '性别：0->未知；1->男；2->女',
2723 |   `birthday` date NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '生日',
2724 |   `city` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '所做城市',
2725 |   `job` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '职业',
2726 |   `personalized_signature` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '个性签名',
2727 |   `source_type` int(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '用户来源',
2728 |   `integration` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '积分',
2729 |   `growth` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '成长值',
2730 |   `luckey_count` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '剩余抽奖次数',
2731 |   `history_integration` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '历史积分数量',
2732 |   PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE,
2733 |   UNIQUE INDEX `idx_username`(`username`) USING BTREE,
2734 |   UNIQUE INDEX `idx_phone`(`phone`) USING BTREE
2735 | ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 12 CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci COMMENT = '会员表' ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;
```

```java
10 |     private String[] values;
11 |     @Override
12 |     public void initialize(FlagValidator flagValidator) {
13 |         this.values = flagValidator.value();
14 |     }
15 | 
16 |     @Override
17 |     public boolean isValid(Integer value, ConstraintValidatorContext constraintValidatorContext) {
18 |         boolean isValid = false;

20 |             if(values[i].equals(String.valueOf(value))){
21 |                 isValid = true;
22 |                 break;
23 |             }
24 |         }
25 |         return isValid;
```

```java
 1 | package com.macro.mall.demo.component;
 2 | 
 3 | import feign.RequestInterceptor;
 4 | import feign.RequestTemplate;
 5 | import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 6 | import org.springframework.web.context.request.RequestContextHolder;
 7 | import org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletRequestAttributes;
 8 | 
 9 | import java.util.Enumeration;
10 | 
11 | /**
12 |  * 用于Feign传递请求头的拦截器
13 |  * Created by macro on 2019/10/18.
14 |  */
15 | public class FeignRequestInterceptor implements RequestInterceptor {
16 |     @Override
17 |     public void apply(RequestTemplate requestTemplate) {
18 |         ServletRequestAttributes attributes = (ServletRequestAttributes) RequestContextHolder
19 |                 .getRequestAttributes();
20 |         if (attributes != null) {
21 |             HttpServletRequest request = attributes.getRequest();
22 |             Enumeration<String> headerNames = request.getHeaderNames();
23 |             //在调用需要认证请求的内部接口时，需要获取原认证头并设置到requestTemplate中去
24 |             if (headerNames != null) {
25 |                 while (headerNames.hasMoreElements()) {
26 |                     String name = headerNames.nextElement();
27 |                     //传递content-length头会导致java.io.IOException: Incomplete output stream问题
28 |                     if ("content-length".equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
29 |                         continue;
30 |                     }
31 |                     String values = request.getHeader(name);
32 |                     requestTemplate.header(name, values);
33 |                 }
34 |             }
35 |         }
36 |     }
37 | }
```

```java
10 | /**
```

```java
15 | @Configuration

27 | 
28 |         return new CorsWebFilter(source);
29 |     }

31 | }
```

```java
  1 | package com.macro.mall.config;
  2 | 
  3 | import cn.dev33.satoken.context.SaHolder;
  4 | import cn.dev33.satoken.exception.NotLoginException;
  5 | import cn.dev33.satoken.exception.NotPermissionException;
  6 | import cn.dev33.satoken.reactor.context.SaReactorSyncHolder;
  7 | import cn.dev33.satoken.reactor.filter.SaReactorFilter;
  8 | import cn.dev33.satoken.router.SaHttpMethod;
  9 | import cn.dev33.satoken.router.SaRouter;
 10 | import cn.dev33.satoken.stp.StpUtil;
 11 | import cn.hutool.core.collection.CollUtil;
 12 | import cn.hutool.core.convert.Convert;
 13 | import com.macro.mall.common.api.CommonResult;
 14 | import com.macro.mall.common.constant.AuthConstant;
 15 | import com.macro.mall.util.StpMemberUtil;
 16 | import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 17 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 18 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
 19 | import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate;
 20 | import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
 21 | import org.springframework.http.server.reactive.ServerHttpResponse;
 22 | import org.springframework.util.AntPathMatcher;
 23 | import org.springframework.util.PathMatcher;
 24 | import org.springframework.web.server.ServerWebExchange;
 25 | 
 26 | import java.util.*;
 27 | 
 28 | /**
 29 |  * @auther macrozheng
 30 |  * @description Sa-Token相关配置
 31 |  * @date 2023/11/28
 32 |  * @github https://github.com/macrozheng
 33 |  */
 34 | @Configuration
 35 | public class SaTokenConfig {
 36 | 
 37 |     @Autowired
 38 |     private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
 39 | 
 40 |     /**
 41 |      * 注册Sa-Token全局过滤器
 42 |      */
 43 |     @Bean
 44 |     public SaReactorFilter getSaReactorFilter(IgnoreUrlsConfig ignoreUrlsConfig) {
 45 |         return new SaReactorFilter()
 46 |                 // 拦截地址
 47 |                 .addInclude("/**")
 48 |                 // 配置白名单路径
 49 |                 .setExcludeList(ignoreUrlsConfig.getUrls())
 50 |                 // 鉴权方法：每次访问进入
 51 |                 .setAuth(obj -> {
 52 |                     // 对于OPTIONS预检请求直接放行
 53 |                     SaRouter.match(SaHttpMethod.OPTIONS).stop();
 54 |                     // 登录认证：商城前台会员认证
 55 |                     SaRouter.match("/mall-portal/**", r -> StpMemberUtil.checkLogin()).stop();
 56 |                     // 登录认证：管理后台用户认证
 57 |                     SaRouter.match("/mall-admin/**", r -> StpUtil.checkLogin());
 58 |                     // 权限认证：管理后台用户权限校验
 59 |                     // 获取Redis中缓存的各个接口路径所需权限规则
 60 |                     Map<Object, Object> pathResourceMap = redisTemplate.opsForHash().entries(AuthConstant.PATH_RESOURCE_MAP);
 61 |                     // 获取到访问当前接口所需权限（一个路径对应多个资源时，拥有任意一个资源都可以访问该路径）
 62 |                     List<String> needPermissionList = new ArrayList<>();
 63 |                     // 获取当前请求路径
 64 |                     String requestPath = SaHolder.getRequest().getRequestPath();
 65 |                     // 创建路径匹配器
 66 |                     PathMatcher pathMatcher = new AntPathMatcher();
 67 |                     Set<Map.Entry<Object, Object>> entrySet = pathResourceMap.entrySet();
 68 |                     for (Map.Entry<Object, Object> entry : entrySet) {
 69 |                         String pattern = (String) entry.getKey();
 70 |                         if (pathMatcher.match(pattern, requestPath)) {
 71 |                             needPermissionList.add((String) entry.getValue());
 72 |                         }
 73 |                     }
 74 |                     // 接口需要权限时鉴权
 75 |                     if(CollUtil.isNotEmpty(needPermissionList)){
 76 |                         SaRouter.match(requestPath, r -> StpUtil.checkPermissionOr(Convert.toStrArray(needPermissionList)));
 77 |                     }
 78 |                 })
 79 |                 // setAuth方法异常处理
 80 |                 .setError(this::handleException);
 81 |     }
 82 | 
 83 |     /**
 84 |      * 自定义异常处理
 85 |      */
 86 |     private CommonResult handleException(Throwable e) {
 87 |         //设置错误返回格式为JSON
 88 |         ServerWebExchange exchange = SaReactorSyncHolder.getContext();
 89 |         HttpHeaders headers = exchange.getResponse().getHeaders();
 90 |         headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8");
 91 |         headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
 92 |         headers.set("Cache-Control","no-cache");
 93 |         CommonResult result = null;
 94 |         if(e instanceof NotLoginException){
 95 |             result = CommonResult.unauthorized(null);
 96 |         }else if(e instanceof NotPermissionException){
 97 |             result = CommonResult.forbidden(null);
 98 |         }else{
 99 |             result = CommonResult.failed(e.getMessage());
100 |         }
101 |         return result;
102 |     }
103 | }
104 | 
```

```xml
10 |             <result column="type" property="type"/>
11 |             <result column="name" property="name"/>
12 |         </collection>
13 |     </resultMap>

15 |         select
16 |             p.id id,
17 |             p.product_sn productSn,
18 |             p.brand_id brandId,
19 |             p.brand_name brandName,
20 |             p.product_category_id productCategoryId,
21 |             p.product_category_name productCategoryName,
22 |             p.pic pic,
23 |             p.name name,
24 |             p.sub_title subTitle,
25 |             p.price price,
26 |             p.sale sale,
27 |             p.new_status newStatus,
28 |             p.recommand_status recommandStatus,
29 |             p.stock stock,
30 |             p.promotion_type promotionType,
31 |             p.keywords keywords,
32 |             p.sort sort,
33 |             pav.id attr_id,
34 |             pav.value attr_value,
35 |             pav.product_attribute_id attr_product_attribute_id,

38 |         from pms_product p

40 |         left join pms_product_attribute pa on pav.product_attribute_id= pa.id

43 |             and p.id=#{id}
44 |         </if>
45 |     </select>
46 | </mapper>
```

```java
 92 |     @Override
 93 |     public Page<EsProduct> search(String keyword, Long brandId, Long productCategoryId, Integer pageNum, Integer pageSize,Integer sort) {
 94 |         Pageable pageable = PageRequest.of(pageNum, pageSize);
 95 |         NativeQueryBuilder nativeQueryBuilder = new NativeQueryBuilder();
 96 |         //分页
 97 |         nativeQueryBuilder.withPageable(pageable);
 98 |         //过滤
 99 |         if (brandId != null || productCategoryId != null) {
100 |             Query boolQuery = QueryBuilders.bool(builder -> {
101 |                 if (brandId != null) {
102 |                     builder.must(QueryBuilders.term(b -> b.field("brandId").value(brandId)));
103 |                 }
104 |                 if (productCategoryId != null) {
105 |                     builder.must(QueryBuilders.term(b -> b.field("productCategoryId").value(productCategoryId)));
106 |                 }
107 |                 return builder;
108 |             });
109 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withFilter(boolQuery);
110 |         }
111 |         //搜索
112 |         if (StrUtil.isEmpty(keyword)) {
113 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withQuery(QueryBuilders.matchAll(builder -> builder));
114 |         } else {
115 |             List<FunctionScore> functionScoreList = new ArrayList<>();
116 |             functionScoreList.add(new FunctionScore.Builder()
117 |                     .filter(QueryBuilders.match(builder -> builder.field("name").query(keyword)))
118 |                     .weight(10.0)
119 |                     .build());
120 |             functionScoreList.add(new FunctionScore.Builder()
121 |                     .filter(QueryBuilders.match(builder -> builder.field("subTitle").query(keyword)))
122 |                     .weight(5.0)
123 |                     .build());
124 |             functionScoreList.add(new FunctionScore.Builder()
125 |                     .filter(QueryBuilders.match(builder -> builder.field("keywords").query(keyword)))
126 |                     .weight(2.0)
127 |                     .build());
128 |             FunctionScoreQuery.Builder functionScoreQueryBuilder = QueryBuilders.functionScore()
129 |                     .functions(functionScoreList)
130 |                     .scoreMode(FunctionScoreMode.Sum)
131 |                     .minScore(2.0);
132 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withQuery(builder -> builder.functionScore(functionScoreQueryBuilder.build()));
133 |         }
134 |         //排序
135 |         if(sort==1){
136 |             //按新品从新到旧
137 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withSort(Sort.by(Sort.Order.desc("id")));
138 |         }else if(sort==2){
139 |             //按销量从高到低
140 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withSort(Sort.by(Sort.Order.desc("sale")));
141 |         }else if(sort==3){
142 |             //按价格从低到高
143 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withSort(Sort.by(Sort.Order.asc("price")));
144 |         }else if(sort==4){
145 |             //按价格从高到低
146 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withSort(Sort.by(Sort.Order.desc("price")));
147 |         }
148 |         //按相关度
149 |         nativeQueryBuilder.withSort(Sort.by(Sort.Order.desc("_score")));
150 |         NativeQuery nativeQuery = nativeQueryBuilder.build();
151 |         LOGGER.info("DSL:{}", nativeQuery.getQuery().toString());
152 |         SearchHits<EsProduct> searchHits = elasticsearchTemplate.search(nativeQuery, EsProduct.class);
153 |         if(searchHits.getTotalHits()<=0){
154 |             return new PageImpl<>(ListUtil.empty(),pageable,0);
155 |         }
156 |         List<EsProduct> searchProductList = searchHits.stream().map(SearchHit::getContent).collect(Collectors.toList());
157 |         return new PageImpl<>(searchProductList,pageable,searchHits.getTotalHits());
158 |     }

214 |     @Override
215 |     public EsProductRelatedInfo searchRelatedInfo(String keyword) {
216 |         NativeQueryBuilder nativeQueryBuilder = new NativeQueryBuilder();
217 |         //搜索条件
218 |         if(StrUtil.isEmpty(keyword)){
219 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withQuery(QueryBuilders.matchAll(builder -> builder));
220 |         }else{
221 |             nativeQueryBuilder.withQuery(QueryBuilders.multiMatch(builder -> builder.fields("name","subTitle","keywords").query(keyword)));
222 |         }
223 |         //聚合搜索品牌名称
224 |         nativeQueryBuilder.withAggregation("brandNames",AggregationBuilders.terms(builder -> builder.field("brandName").size(10)));
225 |         //聚合搜索分类名称
226 |         nativeQueryBuilder.withAggregation("productCategoryNames",AggregationBuilders.terms(builder -> builder.field("productCategoryName").size(10)));
227 |         //聚合搜索商品属性，去除type=0的属性
228 |         Aggregation aggregation = new Aggregation.Builder().nested(builder -> builder.path("attrValueList"))
229 |                 .aggregations("productAttrs",new Aggregation.Builder()
230 |                         .filter(b->b.term(a->a.field("attrValueList.type").value("1")))
231 |                         .aggregations("attrIds",new Aggregation.Builder().terms(b->b.field("attrValueList.productAttributeId").size(10))
232 |                                 .aggregations("attrValues",new Aggregation.Builder().terms(b->b.field("attrValueList.value").size(10)).build())
233 |                                 .aggregations("attrNames",new Aggregation.Builder().terms(b->b.field("attrValueList.name").size(10)).build())
234 |                                 .build()).build()).build();
235 |         nativeQueryBuilder.withAggregation("allAttrValues",aggregation);
236 |         NativeQuery nativeQuery = nativeQueryBuilder.build();
237 |         LOGGER.info("DSL:{}", nativeQueryBuilder.getQuery().toString());
238 |         SearchHits<EsProduct> searchHits = elasticsearchTemplate.search(nativeQuery, EsProduct.class);
239 |         return convertProductRelatedInfo(searchHits);
240 |     }

242 |     /**
243 |      * 将返回结果转换为对象
244 |      */
245 |     private EsProductRelatedInfo convertProductRelatedInfo(SearchHits<EsProduct> response) {
246 |         EsProductRelatedInfo productRelatedInfo = new EsProductRelatedInfo();
247 |         Map<String, ElasticsearchAggregation> esAggregationMap = ((ElasticsearchAggregations) response.getAggregations()).aggregationsAsMap();
248 |         //设置品牌
249 |         ElasticsearchAggregation brandNames = esAggregationMap.get("brandNames");
250 |         List<String> brandNameList = new ArrayList<>();
251 |         List<StringTermsBucket> brandNameBuckets = ((StringTermsAggregate) brandNames.aggregation().getAggregate()._get()).buckets().array();
252 |         for(int i = 0; i<brandNameBuckets.size(); i++){
253 |             brandNameList.add(brandNameBuckets.get(i).key().stringValue());
254 |         }
255 |         productRelatedInfo.setBrandNames(brandNameList);
256 |         //设置分类
257 |         ElasticsearchAggregation productCategoryNames = esAggregationMap.get("productCategoryNames");
258 |         List<String> productCategoryNameList = new ArrayList<>();
259 |         List<StringTermsBucket> productCategoryNameBuckets = ((StringTermsAggregate) productCategoryNames.aggregation().getAggregate()._get()).buckets().array();
260 |         for(int i = 0; i<productCategoryNameBuckets.size(); i++){
261 |             productCategoryNameList.add(productCategoryNameBuckets.get(i).key().stringValue());
262 |         }
263 |         productRelatedInfo.setProductCategoryNames(productCategoryNameList);
264 |         //设置参数
265 |         ElasticsearchAggregation productAttrs = esAggregationMap.get("allAttrValues");
266 |         List<LongTermsBucket> attrIdBuckets = ((LongTermsAggregate) ((FilterAggregate) ((NestedAggregate) productAttrs.aggregation().getAggregate()._get()).aggregations().get("productAttrs")._get()).aggregations().get("attrIds")._get()).buckets().array();
267 |         List<EsProductRelatedInfo.ProductAttr> attrList = new ArrayList<>();
268 |         for (LongTermsBucket item : attrIdBuckets) {
269 |             EsProductRelatedInfo.ProductAttr attr = new EsProductRelatedInfo.ProductAttr();
270 |             attr.setAttrId(item.key());
271 |             List<String> attrValueList = new ArrayList<>();
272 |             List<StringTermsBucket> attrValues = ((StringTermsAggregate) item.aggregations().get("attrValues")._get()).buckets().array();
273 |             List<StringTermsBucket> attrNames = ((StringTermsAggregate) item.aggregations().get("attrNames")._get()).buckets().array();
274 |             for (StringTermsBucket attrValue : attrValues) {
275 |                 attrValueList.add(attrValue.key().stringValue());
276 |             }
277 |             attr.setAttrValues(attrValueList);
278 |             if(!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(attrNames)){
279 |                 String attrName = attrNames.get(0).key().stringValue();
280 |                 attr.setAttrName(attrName);
281 |             }
282 |             attrList.add(attr);
283 |         }
284 |         productRelatedInfo.setProductAttrs(attrList);
285 |         return productRelatedInfo;
286 |     }
287 | }
```

```xml
  1 | <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
  2 | <!DOCTYPE configuration>
  3 | <configuration>
  4 |     <!--引用默认日志配置-->
  5 |     <include resource="org/springframework/boot/logging/logback/defaults.xml"/>
  6 |     <!--使用默认的控制台日志输出实现-->
  7 |     <include resource="org/springframework/boot/logging/logback/console-appender.xml"/>
  8 |     <!--应用名称-->
  9 |     <springProperty scope="context" name="APP_NAME" source="spring.application.name" defaultValue="springBoot"/>
 10 |     <!--日志文件保存路径-->
 11 |     <property name="LOG_FILE_PATH" value="${LOG_FILE:-${LOG_PATH:-${LOG_TEMP:-${java.io.tmpdir:-/tmp}}}/logs}"/>
 12 |     <!--LogStash访问host-->
 13 |     <springProperty name="LOG_STASH_HOST" scope="context" source="logstash.host" defaultValue="localhost"/>
 14 |     <!--是否开启LogStash插件内部日志-->
 15 |     <springProperty name="ENABLE_INNER_LOG" scope="context" source="logstash.enableInnerLog" defaultValue="false"/>
 16 |     <!--配置不打印logback内部的状态信息，排查logback配置问题时可注释掉-->
 17 |     <statusListener class="ch.qos.logback.core.status.NopStatusListener" />
 18 |     <!--DEBUG日志输出到文件-->
 19 |     <appender name="FILE_DEBUG"
 20 |               class="ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.RollingFileAppender">
 21 |         <!--输出DEBUG以上级别日志-->
 22 |         <filter class="ch.qos.logback.classic.filter.ThresholdFilter">
 23 |             <level>DEBUG</level>
 24 |         </filter>
 25 |         <encoder>
 26 |             <!--设置为默认的文件日志格式-->
 27 |             <pattern>${FILE_LOG_PATTERN}</pattern>
 28 |             <charset>UTF-8</charset>
 29 |         </encoder>
 30 |         <rollingPolicy class="ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.SizeAndTimeBasedRollingPolicy">
 31 |             <!--设置文件命名格式-->
 32 |             <fileNamePattern>${LOG_FILE_PATH}/debug/${APP_NAME}-%d{yyyy-MM-dd}-%i.log</fileNamePattern>
 33 |             <!--设置日志文件大小，超过就重新生成文件，默认10M-->
 34 |             <maxFileSize>${LOG_FILE_MAX_SIZE:-10MB}</maxFileSize>
 35 |             <!--日志文件保留天数，默认30天-->
 36 |             <maxHistory>${LOG_FILE_MAX_HISTORY:-30}</maxHistory>
 37 |         </rollingPolicy>
 38 |     </appender>
 39 | 
 40 |     <!--ERROR日志输出到文件-->
 41 |     <appender name="FILE_ERROR"
 42 |               class="ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.RollingFileAppender">
 43 |         <!--只输出ERROR级别的日志-->
 44 |         <filter class="ch.qos.logback.classic.filter.LevelFilter">
 45 |             <level>ERROR</level>
 46 |             <onMatch>ACCEPT</onMatch>
 47 |             <onMismatch>DENY</onMismatch>
 48 |         </filter>
 49 |         <encoder>
 50 |             <!--设置为默认的文件日志格式-->
 51 |             <pattern>${FILE_LOG_PATTERN}</pattern>
 52 |             <charset>UTF-8</charset>
 53 |         </encoder>
```

```xml
 10 |     <!--日志文件保存路径-->

 37 |         </rollingPolicy>
 38 |     </appender>
 39 |
```

```java
 7 | import com.macro.mall.common.service.RedisService;
 8 | import com.macro.mall.common.service.impl.RedisServiceImpl;
 9 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
10 | import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
11 | import org.springframework.data.redis.cache.RedisCacheConfiguration;
12 | import org.springframework.data.redis.cache.RedisCacheManager;
13 | import org.springframework.data.redis.cache.RedisCacheWriter;
14 | import org.springframework.data.redis.connection.RedisConnectionFactory;
15 | import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate;
16 | import org.springframework.data.redis.serializer.Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer;
17 | import org.springframework.data.redis.serializer.RedisSerializationContext;
18 | import org.springframework.data.redis.serializer.RedisSerializer;
19 | import org.springframework.data.redis.serializer.StringRedisSerializer;
20 | 
21 | import java.time.Duration;
22 | 
23 | /**
24 |  * Redis基础配置
25 |  * Created by macro on 2020/6/19.
26 |  */
27 | public class BaseRedisConfig {
28 | 
29 |     @Bean
30 |     public RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate(RedisConnectionFactory redisConnectionFactory) {
31 |         RedisSerializer<Object> serializer = redisSerializer();
32 |         RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate = new RedisTemplate<>();
33 |         redisTemplate.setConnectionFactory(redisConnectionFactory);
34 |         redisTemplate.setKeySerializer(new StringRedisSerializer());
35 |         redisTemplate.setValueSerializer(serializer);
36 |         redisTemplate.setHashKeySerializer(new StringRedisSerializer());
37 |         redisTemplate.setHashValueSerializer(serializer);
38 |         redisTemplate.afterPropertiesSet();
39 |         return redisTemplate;
40 |     }
41 | 
42 |     @Bean
43 |     public RedisSerializer<Object> redisSerializer() {
44 |         //创建JSON序列化器
45 |         Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer<Object> serializer = new Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer<>(Object.class);
46 |         ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
47 |         objectMapper.setVisibility(PropertyAccessor.ALL, JsonAutoDetect.Visibility.ANY);
48 |         //必须设置，否则无法将JSON转化为对象，会转化成Map类型
49 |         objectMapper.activateDefaultTyping(LaissezFaireSubTypeValidator.instance,ObjectMapper.DefaultTyping.NON_FINAL);
50 |         serializer.setObjectMapper(objectMapper);
51 |         return serializer;
52 |     }
53 | 
54 |     @Bean
55 |     public RedisCacheManager redisCacheManager(RedisConnectionFactory redisConnectionFactory) {
56 |         RedisCacheWriter redisCacheWriter = RedisCacheWriter.nonLockingRedisCacheWriter(redisConnectionFactory);
57 |         //设置Redis缓存有效期为1天
58 |         RedisCacheConfiguration redisCacheConfiguration = RedisCacheConfiguration.defaultCacheConfig()
59 |                 .serializeValuesWith(RedisSerializationContext.SerializationPair.fromSerializer(redisSerializer())).entryTtl(Duration.ofDays(1));
60 |         return new RedisCacheManager(redisCacheWriter, redisCacheConfiguration);
61 |     }
62 | 
63 | 
64 |     @Bean
65 |     public RedisService redisService(){
66 |         return new RedisServiceImpl();
67 |     }
68 | 
69 | }
```

```java
  1 | package com.macro.mall.common.log;
  2 | 
  3 | import cn.hutool.core.util.StrUtil;
  4 | import cn.hutool.core.util.URLUtil;
  5 | import cn.hutool.json.JSONUtil;
  6 | import com.macro.mall.common.domain.WebLog;
  7 | import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
  8 | import net.logstash.logback.marker.Markers;
  9 | import org.aspectj.lang.JoinPoint;
 10 | import org.aspectj.lang.ProceedingJoinPoint;
 11 | import org.aspectj.lang.Signature;
 12 | import org.aspectj.lang.annotation.*;
 13 | import org.aspectj.lang.reflect.MethodSignature;
 14 | import org.slf4j.Logger;
 15 | import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 16 | import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;
 17 | import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 18 | import org.springframework.util.StringUtils;
 19 | import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
 20 | import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
 21 | import org.springframework.web.context.request.RequestContextHolder;
 22 | import org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletRequestAttributes;
 23 | 
 24 | import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 25 | import java.lang.reflect.Method;
 26 | import java.lang.reflect.Parameter;
 27 | import java.util.ArrayList;
 28 | import java.util.HashMap;
 29 | import java.util.List;
 30 | import java.util.Map;
 31 | 
 32 | /**
 33 |  * 统一日志处理切面
 34 |  * Created by macro on 2018/4/26.
 35 |  */
 36 | @Aspect
 37 | @Component
 38 | @Order(1)
 39 | public class WebLogAspect {
 40 |     private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WebLogAspect.class);
 41 | 
 42 |     @Pointcut("execution(public * com.macro.mall.controller.*.*(..))||execution(public * com.macro.mall.*.controller.*.*(..))")
 43 |     public void webLog() {
 44 |     }
 45 | 
 46 |     @Before("webLog()")
 47 |     public void doBefore(JoinPoint joinPoint) throws Throwable {
 48 |     }
 49 | 
 50 |     @AfterReturning(value = "webLog()", returning = "ret")
 51 |     public void doAfterReturning(Object ret) throws Throwable {
 52 |     }
 53 | 
 54 |     @Around("webLog()")
 55 |     public Object doAround(ProceedingJoinPoint joinPoint) throws Throwable {
 56 |         long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 57 |         //获取当前请求对象
 58 |         ServletRequestAttributes attributes = (ServletRequestAttributes) RequestContextHolder.getRequestAttributes();
 59 |         HttpServletRequest request = attributes.getRequest();
 60 |         //记录请求信息(通过Logstash传入Elasticsearch)
 61 |         WebLog webLog = new WebLog();
 62 |         Object result = joinPoint.proceed();
 63 |         Signature signature = joinPoint.getSignature();
 64 |         MethodSignature methodSignature = (MethodSignature) signature;
 65 |         Method method = methodSignature.getMethod();
 66 |         if (method.isAnnotationPresent(Operation.class)) {
 67 |             Operation log = method.getAnnotation(Operation.class);
 68 |             webLog.setDescription(log.summary());
 69 |         }
 70 |         long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 71 |         String urlStr = request.getRequestURL().toString();
 72 |         webLog.setBasePath(StrUtil.removeSuffix(urlStr, URLUtil.url(urlStr).getPath()));
 73 |         webLog.setIp(request.getRemoteUser());
 74 |         webLog.setMethod(request.getMethod());
 75 |         webLog.setParameter(getParameter(method, joinPoint.getArgs()));
 76 |         webLog.setResult(result);
 77 |         webLog.setSpendTime((int) (endTime - startTime));
 78 |         webLog.setStartTime(startTime);
 79 |         webLog.setUri(request.getRequestURI());
 80 |         webLog.setUrl(request.getRequestURL().toString());
 81 |         Map<String,Object> logMap = new HashMap<>();
 82 |         logMap.put("url",webLog.getUrl());
 83 |         logMap.put("method",webLog.getMethod());
 84 |         logMap.put("parameter",webLog.getParameter());
 85 |         logMap.put("spendTime",webLog.getSpendTime());
 86 |         logMap.put("description",webLog.getDescription());
 87 | //        LOGGER.info("{}", JSONUtil.parse(webLog));
 88 |         LOGGER.info(Markers.appendEntries(logMap), JSONUtil.parse(webLog).toString());
 89 |         return result;
 90 |     }
 91 | 
 92 |     /**
 93 |      * 根据方法和传入的参数获取请求参数
 94 |      */
 95 |     private Object getParameter(Method method, Object[] args) {
 96 |         List<Object> argList = new ArrayList<>();
 97 |         Parameter[] parameters = method.getParameters();
 98 |         for (int i = 0; i < parameters.length; i++) {
 99 |             //将RequestBody注解修饰的参数作为请求参数
100 |             RequestBody requestBody = parameters[i].getAnnotation(RequestBody.class);
101 |             if (requestBody != null) {
102 |                 argList.add(args[i]);
103 |             }
104 |             //将RequestParam注解修饰的参数作为请求参数
105 |             RequestParam requestParam = parameters[i].getAnnotation(RequestParam.class);
106 |             if (requestParam != null) {
107 |                 Map<String, Object> map = new HashMap<>();
108 |                 String key = parameters[i].getName();
109 |                 if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(requestParam.value())) {
110 |                     key = requestParam.value();
111 |                 }
112 |                 map.put(key, args[i]);
113 |                 argList.add(map);
114 |             }
115 |         }
116 |         if (argList.size() == 0) {
117 |             return null;
118 |         } else if (argList.size() == 1) {
119 |             return argList.get(0);
120 |         } else {
121 |             return argList;
122 |         }
123 |     }
124 | }
```
